ppd;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 关系代数计划树（不可变）。\n *\n * <pre>\n *   plan := Scan(table)\n *         | Filter(predicate, child)\n *         | Project(items, child)            items 至少保持列来源追踪\n *         | InnerJoin(left, right, onPredicates)\n *         | LeftJoin(left, right, onPredicates)   左表为保留侧\n * </pre>\n *\n * schema 由结构推导；列来源用 {@link Column#origin()} 串联，\n * 投影的简单列引用把底层列来源继续向上带，计算列来源为 null。\n */\npublic sealed interface Plan permits Plan.Scan, Plan.Filter, Plan.Project,\n        Plan.InnerJoin, Plan.LeftJoin {\n\n    Schema schema();\n\n    List<Plan> children();\n\n    String typeName();\n\n    /** 基表扫描。 */\n    record Scan(String table, Table tableData) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return tableData.schema(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Scan\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 过滤。predicate 为合取谓词（原样保存，拆分由重写器负责）。 */\n    record Filter(Expr predicate, Plan child) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return child.schema(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(child); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Filter\"; }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 投影。item 为输出列表达式；simpleOrigin 非空表示该输出是对底层某列的简单引用\n     * （用于列来源追踪与谓词下推）。\n     */\n    final class Project implements Plan {\n        private final List<Expr> items;\n        private final Plan child;\n        private final Schema schema;\n\n        public Project(List<Expr> items, Plan child) {\n            this.items = List.copyOf(items);\n            this.child = child;\n            List<Column> out = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Expr e : items) {\n                Column c = columnFor(e, child.schema());\n                out.add(c);\n            }\n            this.schema = new Schema(out);\n        }\n\n        private static Column columnFor(Expr e, Schema input) {\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Ref r) {\n                Column src = input.resolve(r.key());\n                if (src == null) {\n                    throw new EngineException(\"投影引用了不存在的列: \" + r.key());\n                }\n                // 输出列保留来源链；空限定名表示无表别名的裸列\n                return new Column(r.qualifier(), r.name(), src.nullable(), src);\n            }\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Lit l) {\n                return new Column(null, \"expr\", l.value() == null, null);\n            }\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Arith a) {\n                boolean nullable = a.abstractVal(k -> {\n                    Column c = input.resolve(k);\n                    return c == null || c.nullable();\n                }) != Expr.Abs.NN;\n                return new Column(null, \"expr\", nullable, null);\n            }\n            throw new EngineException(\"投影仅支持列引用、常量与算术表达式，得到: \" + e.toSql());\n        }\n\n        public List<Expr> items() { return items; }\n\n        public Plan child() { return child; }\n\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return schema; }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(child); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Project\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 内连接。 */\n    record InnerJoin(Plan left, Plan right, List<Expr> onPredicates) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return joinSchema(left, right); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(left, right); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"InnerJoin\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 左外连接：左表为保留侧，右表列在结果上可能为 NULL。 */\n    record LeftJoin(Plan left, Plan right, List<Expr> onPredicates) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() {\n            Schema base = joinSchema(left, right);\n            // 右表列（可能因不匹配被补 NULL）：全部标记 nullable\n            int split = left.schema().size();\n            List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < base.size(); i++) {\n                Column c = base.get(i);\n                cols.add(i >= split ? c.withNullable(true) : c);\n            }\n            return new Schema(cols);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(left, right); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"LeftJoin\"; }\n    }\n\n    private static Schema joinSchema(Plan l, Plan r) {\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>(l.schema().columns());\n        cols.addAll(r.schema().columns());\n        return new Schema(cols);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // JSON 计划解析\n    //\n    // {\"op\":\"filter\",\"predicate\":\"...\",\"child\":{...}}\n    // {\"op\":\"project\",\"items\":[\"a\",\"a+b\",...],\"child\":{...}}\n    // {\"op\":\"join\",\"joinType\":\"inner|left\",\"on\":[\"...\",\"...\"],\"left\":{...},\"right\":{...}}\n    // {\"op\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"t\"}\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    static Plan fromJson(Map<String, Object> node, Map<String, Table> tables) {\n        String op = Json.getStr(node, \"op\");\n        return switch (op) {\n            case \"scan\" -> parseScan(node, tables);\n            case \"filter\" -> {\n                Plan child = fromJson(Json.getObj(node, \"child\"), tables);\n                Expr pred = ExprParser.parse(Json.getStr(node, \"predicate\"));\n                yield new Filter(pred, child);\n            }\n            case \"project\" -> {\n                Plan child = fromJson(Json.getObj(node, \"child\"), tables);\n                List<Expr> items = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Object it : Json.arr(node.get(\"items\"))) {\n                    items.add(ExprParser.parse(it.toString()));\n                }\n                yield new Project(items, child);\n            }\n            case \"join\" -> {\n                Plan left = fromJson(Json.getObj(node, \"left\"), tables);\n                Plan right = fromJson(Json.getObj(node, \"right\"), tables);\n                List<Expr> ons = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Object it : Json.arr(node.get(\"on\"))) {\n                    ons.add(ExprParser.parse(it.toString()));\n                }\n                String joinType = Json.getStr(node, \"joinType\");\n                if (joinType == null || \"inner\".equalsIgnoreCase(joinType)) {\n                    yield new InnerJoin(left, right, ons);\n                }\n                if (\"left\".equalsIgnoreCase(joinType)) {\n                    yield new LeftJoin(left, right, ons);\n                }\n                throw new EngineException(\"不支持的连接类型: \" + joinType);\n            }\n            default -> throw new EngineException(\"未知计划节点 op=\" + op);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static Scan parseScan(Map<String, Object> node, Map<String, Table> tables) {\n        String name = Json.getStr(node, \"table\");\n        Table t = tables.get(name);\n        if (t == null) throw new EngineException(\"计划引用了未提供的表: \" + name);\n        return new Scan(name, t);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_85812afd548404b82e46ee96","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1566,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":54072,"output_tokens":1944,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_zmzfenkz476cv9zxoia0sm7b":{"content":"package interface Plan permits Plan.Scan, Plan.Filter, Plan.Project,\n        Plan.InnerJoin, Plan.LeftJoin {\n\n    Schema schema();\n\n    List<Plan> children();\n\n    String typeName();\n\n    /** 基表扫描。 */\n    record Scan(String table, Table tableData) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return tableData.schema(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Scan\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 过滤。predicate 为合取谓词（原样保存，拆分由重写器负责）。 */\n    record Filter(Expr predicate, Plan child) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return child.schema(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(child); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Filter\"; }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 投影。item 为输出列表达式；simpleOrigin 非空表示该输出是对底层某列的简单引用\n     * （用于列来源追踪与谓词下推）。\n     */\n    final class Project implements Plan {\n        private final List<Expr> items;\n        private final Plan child;\n        private final Schema schema;\n\n        public Project(List<Expr> items, Plan child) {\n            this.items = List.copyOf(items);\n            this.child = child;\n            List<Column> out = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Expr e : items) {\n                Column c = columnFor(e, child.schema());\n                out.add(c);\n            }\n            this.schema = new Schema(out);\n        }\n\n        private static Column columnFor(Expr e, Schema input) {\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Ref r) {\n                Column src = input.resolve(r.key());\n                if (src == null) {\n                    throw new EngineException(\"投影引用了不存在的列: \" + r.key());\n                }\n                // 输出列保留来源链；空限定名表示无表别名的裸列\n                return new Column(r.qualifier(), r.name(), src.nullable(), src);\n            }\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Lit l) {\n                return new Column(null, \"expr\", l.value() == null, null);\n            }\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Arith a) {\n                boolean nullable = a.abstractVal(k -> {\n                    Column c = input.resolve(k);\n                    return c == null || c.nullable();\n                }) != Expr.Abs.NN;\n                return new Column(null, \"expr\", nullable, null);\n            }\n            throw new EngineException(\"投影仅支持列引用、常量与算术表达式，得到: \" + e.toSql());\n        }\n\n        public List<Expr> items() { return items; }\n\n        public Plan child() { return child; }\n\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return schema; }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(child); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Project\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 内连接。 */\n    record InnerJoin(Plan left, Plan right, List<Expr> onPredicates) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return joinSchema(left, right); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(left, right); }\n\n implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() {\n            Schema base = joinSchema(left, right);\n            // 右表列（可能因不匹配被补 NULL）：全部标记 nullable\n            int split = split ? c.withNullable(true) : c);\n            }\n            return new Schema(cols);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(left, right); }\n\n {\"op\":\"join\",\"joinType\":\"inner|left\",\"on\":[\"...\",\"...\"],\"left\":{...},\"right\":{...}}\n    // {\"op\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"t\"}\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    static Plan fromJson(Map<String, Object> node, Map<String, Table> tables) {\n        String op = Json.getStr(node, \"op\");\n {"parentUuid":"931197c9-eec8-4ea6-9c36-b782ba6db68c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_pdkip8z3vnhx23uj7f634a7u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a/src/ppd/Executor.java","content":"package ppd;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 单机内存执行器：对计划树做实际求值。\n *\n * <ul>\n *   <li>Scan   —— 直接返回基表行；</li>\n *   <li>Filter —— 谓词三值逻辑，仅 TRUE 放行（FALSE/UNKNOWN 都丢弃）；</li>\n *   <li>Project—— 逐项求值（包括算术表达式）；</li>\n *   <li>Join   —— 嵌套循环 + 笛卡尔积按 ON 过滤；左连接不匹配补全 NULL 行。</li>\n * </ul>\n */\npublic class Executor {\n\n    public List<Row> execute(Plan plan) {\n        return switch (plan) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> new ArrayList<>(s.tableData().rows());\n            case Plan.Filter f -> execFilter(f);\n            case Plan.Project p -> execProject(p);\n            case Plan.InnerJoin j -> execInner(j);\n            case Plan.LeftJoin j -> execLeft(j);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execFilter(Plan.Filter f) {\n        Schema in = f.child().schema();\n        List<Row> rows = execute(f.child());\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Object v = f.predicate().eval(envFor(r, in));\n            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(v)) out.add(r);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execProject(Plan.Project p) {\n        Schema in = p.child().schema();\n        List<Row> rows = execute(p.child());\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Expr.Env env = envFor(r, in);\n            Row nr = new Row(p.items().size());\n            for (int i = 0; i < p.items().size(); i++) {\n                nr.set(i, p.items().get(i).eval(env));\n            }\n            out.add(nr);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execInner(Plan.InnerJoin j) {\n        List<Row> ls = execute(j.left());\n        List<Row> rs = execute(j.right());\n        Schema lsch = j.left().schema();\n        Schema rsch = j.right().schema();\n        Schema joined = j.schema();\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row l : ls) {\n            for (Row r : rs) {\n                Row joinedRow = l.concat(r);\n                if (matchAll(j.onPredicates(), joinedRow, joined)) out.add(joinedRow);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execLeft(Plan.LeftJoin j) {\n        List<Row> ls = execute(j.left());\n        List<Row> rs = execute(j.right());\n        Schema lsch = j.left().schema();\n        Schema joined = j.schema();\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row l : ls) {\n            boolean matched = false;\n            for (Row r : rs) {\n                Row joinedRow = l.concat(r);\n                if (matchAll(j.onPredicates(), joinedRow, joined)) {\n                    out.add(joinedRow);\n                    matched = true;\n                }\n            }\n            if (!matched) {\n                // 保留行：右表列全部补 NULL\n                out.add(l.concat(Row.nullRow(rsch.size())));\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private boolean matchAll(List<Expr> predicates, Row row, Schema schema) {\n        Expr.Env env = envFor(row, schema);\n        for (Expr e : predicates) {\n            if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(e.eval(env))) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 为一行构造求值环境：把列引用解析到行下标。\n     * 限定名精确匹配；裸列名按 schema 解析（歧义由 Schema.resolve 抛错）。\n     */\n    public static Expr.Env envFor(Row row, Schema schema) {\n        Map<RefKey, Integer> qualified = new HashMap<>();\n        Map<String, Integer> bare = new HashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < schema.size(); i++) {\n            Column c = schema.get(i);\n            qualified.put(new RefKey(c.qualifier(), c.name()), i);\n            bare.put(c.name(), i);\n        }\n        return (qualifier, name) -> {\n            Integer idx;\n            if (qualifier != null) {\n                idx = qualified.get(new RefKey(qualifier, name));\n            } else {\n                Column c = schema.resolve(new RefKey(null, name));\n                if (c == null) {\n                    throw new EngineException(\"列不存在: \" + name);\n                }\n                idx = schema.indexOf(c);\n            }\n            if (idx == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"列不存在: \" + (qualifier == null ? name : qualifier + \".\" + name));\n            }\n            return row.get(idx);\n        };\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_76f3a8de3ce2c8b6c0df35ec","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1225,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":57144,"output_tokens":1442,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_pdkip8z3vnhx23uj7f634a7u":{"content":"package * 每个合取项的“能推 / 不能推”都记录一条 {@link Decision} 理由。\n *\n * <h2>判定依据</h2>\n * <ol>\n *   <li><b>列来源</b>：谓词只引用某一侧 schema 的列（且可穿透简单投影）才能进入该侧；\n *       跨两侧的谓词只能并入内连接 ON（外连接不行）。</li>\n *   <li><b>NULL 拒绝性</b>：左外连接右侧是“NULL 补充侧”。引用右列的 WHERE 谓词，\n *       仅当其在右列可能为 NULL 时绝不为真（rejects nulls），才可下推——\n *       此时必须同时把左外连接<b>降级为内连接</b>，否则会错误删除保留行。</li>\n *   <li>非 NULL 拒绝的右表谓词（如 {@code r.b IS NULL}、{@code r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2}）\n *       必须留在外连接上方。</li>\n * </ol>\n */\npublic class PushdownRewriter {\n\n    /** 一条下推决策。 */\n    public record Decision(String predicate, String action, String reason) {\n        Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"predicate\", predicate);\n            m.put(\"action\", action);\n            m.put(\"reason\", reason);\n            return m;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private final List<Decision> decisions = new ArrayList<>();\n\n    public RewriteResult rewrite(Plan plan) {\n List<Decision> decisions) {}\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 自底向上改写\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan rewriteNode(Plan p) {\n        return switch (p) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> s;\n            case Plan.Filter f -> rewriteFilter(f);\n            case Plan.Project pr -> {\n                Plan newChild = rewriteNode(pr.child());\n                if (newChild == pr.child()) yield pr;\n                yield new Plan.Project(pr.items(), newChild);\n            }\n            case Plan.InnerJoin j ->\n                    new Plan.InnerJoin(rewriteNode(j.left()), rewriteNode(j.right()), j.onPredicates());\n            case Plan.LeftJoin j ->\n                    new Plan.LeftJoin(rewriteNode(j.left()), rewriteNode(j.right()), j.onPredicates());\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Plan rewriteFilter(Plan.Filter f) {\n        Plan child = rewriteNode(f.child());\n        List<Expr> conjuncts = Expr.splitConjunction(f.predicate());\n        return pushConjuncts(conjuncts, child, f.child().schema());\n    }\n\n    /** 把一组合取项推入已改写的子计划。 */\n    private Plan pushConjuncts(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan child, Schema childOutputSchema) {\n        List<Expr> stay = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n            boolean handled = switch (child) {\n                case Plan.Scan s -> pushToScan(c, s);\n                case Plan.Project pr -> pushThroughProject(c, pr, stay);\n                case Plan.InnerJoin j -> pushIntoInnerJoin(c, j, stay);\n                case Plan.LeftJoin lj -> pushIntoLeftJoin(c, lj, stay);\n                default -> false;\n            };\n            if (!handled) stay.add(c);\n        }\n\n        if (stay.isEmpty()) return child;\n        if (stay.size() == 1 && stay.get(0) instanceof Expr.Lit lit && Boolean.FALSE.equals(lit.value())) {\n            // 常量 FALSE 且无法落到任何子节点（例如只剩外连接跨侧谓词）——不会发生，保险起见保留\n            return new Plan.Filter(stay.get(0), child);\n        }\n        return new Plan.Filter(Expr.combineConjunction(stay), child);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Scan：全部下推\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private boolean pushToScan(Expr c, Plan.Scan s) {\n        if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_SCAN\",\n                    \"常量 FALSE：直接作为空结果扫描（下推到表 \" + s.table() + \"）\"));\n        } else {\n            validateRefs(c, s.tableData().schema(), \"扫描 \" + s.table());\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_SCAN\",\n                    \"谓词仅引用表 \" + s.table() + \" 的列，下推为基表过滤，提前丢弃不满足行\"));\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Project：按列来源穿透\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private boolean pushThroughProject(Expr c, Plan.Project pr, List<Expr> stay) {\n        if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n            // 投影不删行，常量 FALSE 可穿透\n            Plan newChild = pushConjuncts(List.of(c), pr.child(), pr.child().schema());\n            replaceProjectChild(pr, newChild);\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_THROUGH_PROJECT\",\n                    \"常量 FALSE 且投影不改变行数，穿透投影下推（结果恒为空）\"));\n            return true;\n        }\n        // 用列来源把输出列名替换为底层列；任一引用是计算列则无法穿透\n        List<String> blocked = new ArrayList<>();\n        Expr mapped = c.mapRefs(r -> {\n            Column out = pr.schema().resolve(r.key());\n            if (out == null) {\n                blocked.add(r.key().toString());\n                return r;\n            }\n            Column origin = out.origin();\n            if (origin == null) {\n                blocked.add(out.display());\n                return r;\n            }\n            return new Expr.Ref(origin.qualifier(), origin.name());\n        });\n        if (!blocked.isEmpty()) {\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"STAY_ABOVE_PROJECT\",\n                    \"引用了投影计算列 \" + blocked + \"，无法按列来源穿透，保留在投影上方\"));\n            return false;\n        }\n        Plan newChild = pushConjuncts(List.of(mapped), pr.child(), pr.child().schema());\n        replaceProjectChild(pr, newChild);\n        decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_THROUGH_PROJECT\",\n                \"谓词引用的列经列来源追踪均为底层列引用，改写为 \"\n                        + mapped.toSql() + \" 穿透投影下推（投影不删行，语义不变）\"));\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    /** Project 不可变，需要就地换子节点时通过替换持有者实现：重建并回填。 */\n    private void replaceProjectChild(Plan.Project pr, Plan newChild) {\n        // 借助 SideChannel 在调用处替换（见 pushConjuncts 的包装方式）\n        throw new UnsupportedOperationException();\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // InnerJoin：左 / 右 / ON / 常量FALSE\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private boolean pushIntoInnerJoin(Expr c, Plan.InnerJoin j, List<Expr> stay) {\n        Schema ls = j.left().schema();\n        Schema rs = j.right().schema();\n\n        if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n            // 内连接任一侧为空 => 结果为空；选左侧落地\n            Plan nl = wrapFilter(c, j.left());\n            pendingWrappers.add(new Wrapper(j, Side.LEFT, nl));\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_LEFT_SIDE\",\n                    \"常量 FALSE：内连接在空关系上结果恒为空，下推至左子树\"));\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        Set<RefKey> refs = c.refs();\n        boolean inLeft = refsAllIn(refs, ls);\n        boolean inRight = refsAllIn(refs, rs);\n\n        if (inLeft && inRight) {\n            if (refs.isEmpty()) {\n                decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"MERGE_INTO_ON\",\n                        \"无列引用的常量谓词，且非 FALSE：结果集不受其影响，并入 ON（恒真）\"));\n                pendingOnMerges.add(new OnMerge(j, c));\n                return true;\n            }\n            // 两侧各自包含全部引用，只可能是无歧义的同名列——实际上不会同时 in 两侧，\n            // 除非无引用；保守按跨侧处理\n        }\n\n        if (inLeft && !inRight) {\n            validateRefs(c, ls, \"内连接左侧\");\n            Plan nl = wrapFilter(c, j.left());\n            pendingWrappers.add(new Wrapper(j, Side.LEFT, nl));\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_LEFT_SIDE\",\n                    \"谓词只引用内连接左表列，先过滤左表可减少连接探测行数，且不改变内连接结果\"));\n            return true;\n        }\n        if (inRight && !inLeft) {\n            validateRefs(c, rs, \"内连接右侧\");\n            Plan nr = wrapFilter(c, j.right());\n            pendingWrappers.add(new Wrapper(j, Side.RIGHT, nr));\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_RIGHT_SIDE\",\n                    \"谓词只引用内连接右表列，先过滤右表不改变内连接结果\"));\n            return true;\n        }\n        // 跨两侧：并入 ON\n        validateRefs(c, j.schema(), \"内连接\");\n        pendingOnMerges.add(new OnMerge(j, c));\n        decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"MERGE_INTO_ON\",\n                \"谓词同时引用连接两侧列，无法单侧下推，并入内连接 ON 条件（等价于连接后过滤）\"));\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // LeftJoin：保留侧 / NULL 补充侧 / 转内连接\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private boolean pushIntoLeftJoin(Expr c, Plan.LeftJoin lj, List<Expr> stay) {\n        Schema ls = lj.left().schema();\n        Schema rs = lj.right().schema();\n\n        if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_PRESERVED_SIDE\",\n                    \"常量 FALSE：仅可下推到左外连接的保留侧（左侧）；\"\n                            + \"若推入 NULL 补充侧会使全部左行成为保留行，改变语义\"));\n            return true;\n validateRefs(c, ls, \"左外连接左侧\");\n            Plan nl = wrapFilter(c, lj.left());\n            pendingWrappers.add(new Wrapper(lj, Side.LEFT, nl));\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_PRESERVED_SIDE\",\n                    \"谓词只引用保留侧（左表）列：保留行的左列永不为补 NULL，\"\n                            + \"连接前过滤等价于连接后过滤\"));\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        if (inRight && !inLeft) {\n            validateRefs(c, rs, \"左外连接右侧\");\n            // NULL 拒绝性：右列在结果中可能为补 NULL\n            Predicate<RefKey> nullable = k -> {\n                Column col = rs.resolve(k);\n Decision(c.toSql(), \"STAY_ABOVE_OUTER_JOIN\",\n                        \"谓词引用 NULL 补充侧（右表）列，但不拒绝 NULL \"\n                                + \"（右列补 NULL 时谓词可能为 TRUE/UNKNOWN 而非必然被过滤），\"\n ConvertToInner(lj);\n            pendingConversions.add(conv);\n            Plan nr = wrapFilter(c, lj.right());\n            pendingWrappers.add(new Wrapper(lj, Side.RIGHT, nr));\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_NULLABLE_SIDE_AND_DOWNGRADE\",\n                    \"谓词引用 NULL 补充侧列且拒绝 NULL（右列全为 NULL 时谓词不可能为 TRUE），\"\n                            + Decision(c.toSql(), \"STAY_ABOVE_OUTER_JOIN\",\n                    \"谓词列无法唯一归入外连接某一侧，保留在连接上方\"));\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // 跨两侧：必须留下。检查是否拒绝右列 NULL——若拒绝可转内连接并并入 ON\n        Predicate<RefKey> nullable = k -> {\n            Column col = rs.resolve(k);\n            // 右列在结果中可为补 NULL；左列按其自身 nullable\n            if (col != null) return true;\n            Column lcol = ls.resolve(k);\n            return lcol == null || lcol.nullable();\n        };\n        boolean rejectsRight = c.isNullRejecting(nullable);\n        if (rejectsRight && refs.stream().anyMatch(k -> rs.resolve(k) != null)) {\n            ConvertToInner conv = new ConvertToInner(lj);\n            pendingConversions.add(conv);\n            pendingOnMerges.add(new OnMerge(lj, c));\n            decisions.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"DOWNGRADE_AND_MERGE_INTO_ON\",\n                    \"跨两侧谓词拒绝右表 NULL（保留行必被过滤）：先将左外连接降级为内连接，\"\n                            + \"再把谓词并入 ON，不改变结果\"));\n record OnMerge(Plan join, Expr predicate) {}\n\n    private record ConvertToInner(Plan.LeftJoin join) {}\n\n    private final List<Wrapper> pendingWrappers = new ArrayList<>();\n    private final FunctionalRewriter 中。）\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static Plan wrapFilter(Expr pred, Plan child) {\n        return new Plan.Filter(pred, child);\n    }\n\n    private boolean refsAllIn(Set<RefKey> refs, Schema s) {\n        for (RefKey k : refs) {\n            if (s.resolve(k) == null) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    private void validateRefs(Expr e, Schema s, String where) {\n        for (RefKey k : e.refs()) {\n            if (s.resolve(k) == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"谓词 \" + e.toSql() + \" 含无法解析到 \" + where + \" 的列: \" + k);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static boolean isConstantFalse(Expr e) {\n        return e instanceof Expr.Lit l && Boolean.FALSE.equals(l.value());\n ppd;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.function.Predicate;\n\n/**\n * 谓词下推重写器（纯函数式：输入计划不变，输出新计划）。\n *\n * 对计划树自底向上改写：把 Filter 的合取项尽量移动到 Scan / 连接子树 / 投影下方。\n * 每个合取项的“能推 / 不能推”都记录一条 {@link Decision} 理由。\n *\n * <h2>判定依据</h2>\n * <ol>\n *   <li><b>列来源</b>：谓词只引用某一侧 schema 的列（且可穿透简单投影）才能进入该侧；\n *       跨两侧的谓词只能并入内连接 ON（外连接不行）。</li>\n *   <li><b>NULL 拒绝性</b>：左外连接右侧是“NULL 补充侧”。引用右列的 WHERE 谓词，\n *       仅当其在右列可能为 NULL 时绝不为真（rejects nulls），才可下推——\n *       此时必须同时把左外连接<b>降级为内连接</b>，否则会错误删除保留行。</li>\n *   <li>非 NULL 拒绝的右表谓词（如 {@code r.b IS NULL}、{@code r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2}）\n *       必须留在外连接上方。</li>\n * </ol>\n */\npublic class PushdownRewriter {\n\n    /** 一条下推决策。 */\n    public record Decision(String predicate, String action, String reason) {\n        public java.util.Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            java.util.Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"predicate\", predicate);\n            m.put(\"action\", action);\n            m.put(\"reason\", reason);\n            return m;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public record RewriteResult(Plan plan, List<Decision> decisions) {}\n\n    public RewriteResult rewrite(Plan plan) {\n        List<Decision> decisions = new ArrayList<>();\n        Plan rewritten = rewriteNode(plan, decisions);\n        return new RewriteResult(rewritten, List.copyOf(decisions));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 自底向上\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan rewriteNode(Plan p, List<Decision> d) {\n        return switch (p) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> s;\n            case Plan.Filter f -> rewriteFilter(f, d);\n            case Plan.Project pr ->\n                    new Plan.Project(pr.items(), rewriteNode(pr.child(), d));\n            case Plan.InnerJoin j ->\n                    new Plan.InnerJoin(rewriteNode(j.left(), d), rewriteNode(j.right(), d),\n                            j.onPredicates());\n            case Plan.LeftJoin j ->\n                    new Plan.LeftJoin(rewriteNode(j.left(), d), rewriteNode(j.right(), d),\n                            j.onPredicates());\n        };\n    }\n\n    private Plan rewriteFilter(Plan.Filter f, List<Decision> d) {\n        Plan child = rewriteNode(f.child(), d);\n        return pushConjuncts(Expr.splitConjunction(f.predicate()), child, d);\n    }\n\n    /** 把一组合取项推入已改写的子计划，返回新计划；推不下去的留在 Filter 里。 */\n    private Plan pushConjuncts(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan child, List<Decision> d) {\n        return switch (child) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> {\n                List<Expr> all = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n                    if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n                        d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_SCAN\",\n                                \"常量 FALSE：下推到表 \" + s.table() + \" 的扫描，结果直接为空\"));\n                    } else {\n                        validateRefs(c, s.tableData().schema());\n                        d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_SCAN\",\n                                \"谓词仅引用表 \" + s.table() + \" 的列，下推为基表过滤，提前丢弃不满足行\"));\n                    }\n                    all.add(c);\n                }\n                yield filterOr(all, child);\n            }\n            case Plan.Project pr -> pushThroughProject(conjuncts, pr, d);\n            case Plan.InnerJoin ij -> pushIntoInnerJoin(conjuncts, ij, d);\n            case Plan.LeftJoin lj -> pushIntoLeftJoin(conjuncts, lj, d);\n            default -> filterOr(conjuncts, child);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static Plan filterOr(List<Expr> preds, Plan child) {\n        if (preds.isEmpty()) return child;\n        return new Plan.Filter(Expr.combineConjunction(preds), child);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Project 穿透\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan pushThroughProject(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan.Project pr, List<Decision> d) {\n        List<Expr> stay = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> below = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n            if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n                // 投影不删行：常量 FALSE 可直接穿透\n                below.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_THROUGH_PROJECT\",\n                        \"常量 FALSE 且投影不改变行数，穿透投影继续下推（结果恒为空）\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<String> blocked = new ArrayList<>();\n            Expr mapped = c.mapRefs(r -> {\n                Column out = pr.schema().resolve(r.key());\n                if (out == null) {\n                    blocked.add(r.key().toString());\n                    return r;\n                }\n                Column origin = out.rootOrigin();\n                if (out.origin() == null) {\n                    // 计算列 / 常量列：无基表来源\n                    blocked.add(out.display());\n                    return r;\n                }\n                return new Expr.Ref(origin.qualifier(), origin.name());\n            });\n            if (!blocked.isEmpty()) {\n                stay.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"STAY_ABOVE_PROJECT\",\n                        \"引用了投影计算列 \" + new LinkedHashSet<>(blocked)\n                                + \"，无法按列来源穿透，保留在投影上方\"));\n            } else {\n                below.add(mapped);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_THROUGH_PROJECT\",\n                        \"谓词引用列经列来源追踪全部来自底层列，改写为 \"\n                                + mapped.toSql() + \" 穿透投影（投影不删行，语义不变）\"));\n            }\n        }\n        Plan newChild = below.isEmpty() ? pr.child()\n                : pushConjuncts(below, pr.child(), d);\n        Plan result = new Plan.Project(pr.items(), newChild);\n        return filterOr(stay, result);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // InnerJoin\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan pushIntoInnerJoin(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan.InnerJoin j, List<Decision> d) {\n        List<Expr> leftPreds = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> rightPreds = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> onPreds = new ArrayList<>(j.onPredicates());\n\n        for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n            if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n                // 内连接任一侧为空 => 结果为空；落到左侧\n                leftPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_LEFT_SIDE\",\n                        \"常量 FALSE：内连接在空关系上结果恒为空，下推至左子树\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n            Set<RefKey> refs = c.refs();\n            boolean inLeft = refsAllIn(refs, j.left().schema());\n            boolean inRight = refsAllIn(refs, j.right().schema());\n\n            if (inLeft && !inRight) {\n                validateRefs(c, j.left().schema());\n                leftPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_LEFT_SIDE\",\n                        \"谓词只引用内连接左表列，先过滤左表减少连接探测行数，不改变内连接结果\"));\n            } else if (inRight && !inLeft) {\n                validateRefs(c, j.right().schema());\n                rightPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_RIGHT_SIDE\",\n                        \"谓词只引用内连接右表列，先过滤右表不改变内连接结果\"));\n            } else if (!inLeft && !inRight) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"谓词 \" + c.toSql() + \" 含无法解析的列引用\");\n            } else {\n                // 同时落在两侧：只可能是无引用的常量（常量 FALSE 已处理），\n                // 或两侧恰好都有同名匹配——裸名歧义在 resolve 中已抛错，这里作跨侧并入 ON\n                validateRefs(c, j.schema());\n                onPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"MERGE_INTO_ON\",\n                        \"谓词引用连接两侧列，无法单侧下推，并入内连接 ON 条件（与连接后过滤等价）\"));\n            }\n        }\n\n        Plan nl = leftPreds.isEmpty() ? j.left()\n                : pushConjuncts(leftPreds, j.left(), d);\n        Plan nr = rightPreds.isEmpty() ? j.right()\n                : pushConjuncts(rightPreds, j.right(), d);\n        return new Plan.InnerJoin(nl, nr, onPreds);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // LeftJoin：保留侧 / NULL 补充侧 / 降级内连接\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan pushIntoLeftJoin(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan.LeftJoin lj, List<Decision> d) {\n        List<Expr> stay = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> leftPreds = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> rightPreds = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> afterDowngrade = new ArrayList<>(); // 转内连接后再分类的跨侧谓词\n        boolean downgrade = false;\n\n        for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n            if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n                // 只能推保留侧：右表被过滤为空会让全部左行变成补 NULL 保留行\n                leftPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_PRESERVED_SIDE\",\n                        \"常量 FALSE：仅可下推到左外连接保留侧（左表）；\"\n                                + \"推入 NULL 补充侧会使全部左行成为保留行，语义改变\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            Set<RefKey> refs = c.refs();\n            boolean inLeft = refsAllIn(refs, lj.left().schema());\n            boolean inRight = refsAllIn(refs, lj.right().schema());\n\n            if (inLeft && !inRight) {\n                validateRefs(c, lj.left().schema());\n                leftPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_PRESERVED_SIDE\",\n                        \"谓词只引用保留侧（左表）列：保留行左列永不为补 NULL，\"\n                                + \"连接前过滤与连接后过滤等价\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if (inRight && !inLeft) {\n                validateRefs(c, lj.right().schema());\n                // 右列在结果上可为补 NULL，判定谓词在“右列任意为 NULL”时能否为 TRUE\n                Predicate<RefKey> nullableRight = k -> {\n                    Column col = lj.right().schema().resolve(k);\n                    return col == null || col.nullable();\n                };\n                if (c.isNullRejecting(nullableRight)) {\n                    downgrade = true;\n                    rightPreds.add(c);\n                    d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"DOWNGRADE_AND_PUSH_RIGHT\",\n                            \"谓词引用 NULL 补充侧（右表）列且拒绝 NULL：右列补 NULL 时谓词不可能为 TRUE，\"\n                                    + \"未匹配的保留行必被过滤，故把左外连接降级为内连接并下推到右表\"));\n                } else {\n                    stay.add(c);\n                    d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"STAY_ABOVE_OUTER_JOIN\",\n                            \"谓词引用 NULL 补充侧（右表）列但不拒绝 NULL，\"\n                                    + \"下推会删除/改变外连接保留行（例如保留行右列全为 NULL），\"\n                                    + \"必须保留在左外连接上方\"));\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if (!inLeft && !inRight) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"谓词 \" + c.toSql() + \" 含无法解析的列引用\");\n            }\n\n            // 跨两侧：只有“拒绝右表 NULL”时才可降级为内连接并入 ON\n            validateRefs(c, jSchema(lj));\n            Predicate<RefKey> nullableMixed = k -> {\n                if (lj.right().schema().resolve(k) != null) return true; // 右列：可能补 NULL\n                Column lcol = lj.left().schema().resolve(k);\n                return lcol == null || lcol.nullable();\n            };\n            boolean usesRight = refs.stream().anyMatch(k -> lj.right().schema().resolve(k) != null);\n            if (usesRight && c.isNullRejecting(nullableMixed)) {\n                downgrade = true;\n                afterDowngrade.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"DOWNGRADE_AND_MERGE_INTO_ON\",\n                        \"跨两侧谓词拒绝右表 NULL（保留行必被过滤）：先将左外连接降级为内连接，\"\n                                + \"再并入 ON 条件，结果不变\"));\n            } else {\n                stay.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), Plan nl = leftPreds.isEmpty() ? lj.left()\n                : pushConjuncts(leftPreds, lj.left(), d);\n        Plan nr = rightPreds.isEmpty() ? lj.right()\n                : pushConjuncts(rightPreds, <li>非 NULL 拒绝的右表谓词（如 {@code r.b IS NULL}、{@code r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2}）\n *       必须留在外连接上方。</li>\n * </ol>\n */\npublic class PushdownRewriter {\n\n    /** 一条下推决策。 */\n    public record Decision(String predicate, String action, String reason) {\n        public java.util.Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            java.util.Map<String, Object> m = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"predicate\", predicate);\n            m.put(\"action\", action);\n            m.put(\"reason\", reason);\n            return m;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public record RewriteResult(Plan plan, List<Decision> decisions) {}\n\n    public RewriteResult rewrite(Plan plan) {\n        List<Decision> decisions = new ArrayList<>();\n        Plan rewritten = rewriteNode(plan, decisions);\n        return new RewriteResult(rewritten, List.copyOf(decisions));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 自底向上\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan rewriteNode(Plan p, List<Decision> d) {\n        return switch (p) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> s;\n            case Plan.Filter f -> rewriteFilter(f, d);\n            case Plan.Project pr ->\n                    new Plan.Project(pr.items(), rewriteNode(pr.child(), d));\n            case Plan.InnerJoin j ->\n                    new Plan.InnerJoin(rewriteNode(j.left(), d), rewriteNode(j.right(), d),\n                            j.onPredicates());\n            case Plan.LeftJoin j ->\n List<Decision> d) {\n        Plan child = rewriteNode(f.child(), d);\n        return pushConjuncts(Expr.splitConjunction(f.predicate()), child, d);\n    }\n\n    /** 把一组合取项推入已改写的子计划，返回新计划；推不下去的留在 Filter 里。 */\n    private Plan pushConjuncts(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan child, List<Decision> d) {\n        return switch (child) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> {\n                List<Expr> all = new ArrayList<>();\n                for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n                    if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n                        d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_SCAN\",\n                                \"常量 FALSE：下推到表 \" + s.table() + \" 的扫描，结果直接为空\"));\n                    } else {\n                        validateRefs(c, s.tableData().schema());\n                        d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_SCAN\",\n                                \"谓词仅引用表 \" + s.table() + \" 的列，下推为基表过滤，提前丢弃不满足行\"));\n                    }\n                    all.add(c);\n pushIntoInnerJoin(conjuncts, ij, d);\n            case Plan.LeftJoin lj -> pushIntoLeftJoin(conjuncts, lj, d);\n            default -> filterOr(conjuncts, child);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static Plan filterOr(List<Expr> preds, Plan child) {\n        if (preds.isEmpty()) return child;\n        return new Plan.Filter(Expr.combineConjunction(preds), child);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Project 穿透\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan pushThroughProject(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan.Project pr, List<Decision> d) {\n        List<Expr> stay = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> below = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n            if (isConstantFalse(c)) {\n                // 投影不删行：常量 FALSE 可直接穿透\n                below.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_THROUGH_PROJECT\",\n                        \"常量 FALSE 且投影不改变行数，穿透投影继续下推（结果恒为空）\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n            List<String> blocked = new ArrayList<>();\n            Expr mapped = c.mapRefs(r -> {\n                Column out = pr.schema().resolve(r.key());\n                if (out == null) {\n                    blocked.add(r.key().toString());\n                    return r;\n                }\n                Column origin = out.rootOrigin();\n                if (out.origin() == null) {\n                    // 计算列 / 常量列：无基表来源\n                    blocked.add(out.display());\n                    return r;\n                }\n                return new Expr.Ref(origin.qualifier(), origin.name());\n            });\n            if (!blocked.isEmpty()) {\n                stay.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"STAY_ABOVE_PROJECT\",\n                        \"引用了投影计算列 \" + new LinkedHashSet<>(blocked)\n                                + \"，无法按列来源穿透，保留在投影上方\"));\n            } else {\n                below.add(mapped);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_THROUGH_PROJECT\",\n                        \"谓词引用列经列来源追踪全部来自底层列，改写为 \"\n // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Plan pushIntoInnerJoin(List<Expr> conjuncts, Plan.InnerJoin j, List<Decision> d) {\n        List<Expr> leftPreds = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> rightPreds = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Expr> onPreds = new ArrayList<>(j.onPredicates());\n\n        for (Expr c : conjuncts) {\n            if FALSE：内连接在空关系上结果恒为空，下推至左子树\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n            Set<RefKey> refs = c.refs();\n            boolean inLeft = refsAllIn(refs, j.left().schema());\n            boolean inRight = refsAllIn(refs, j.right().schema());\n\n            if (inLeft && !inRight) {\n                validateRefs(c, j.left().schema());\n                leftPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_LEFT_SIDE\",\n                        \"谓词只引用内连接左表列，先过滤左表减少连接探测行数，不改变内连接结果\"));\n            } else if (inRight && !inLeft) {\n                validateRefs(c, validateRefs(c, lj.left().schema());\n                leftPreds.add(c);\n                d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"PUSH_TO_PRESERVED_SIDE\",\n                        \"谓词只引用保留侧（左表）列：保留行左列永不为补 NULL，\"\n                                + \"连接前过滤与连接后过滤等价\"));\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            if (inRight && !inLeft) {\n                validateRefs(c, lj.right().schema());\n                // 右列在结果上可为补 NULL，判定谓词在“右列任意为 NULL”时能否为 TRUE\n                Predicate<RefKey> nullableRight = k -> {\n                    Column col = true;\n                    rightPreds.add(c);\n                    d.add(new Decision(c.toSql(), \"DOWNGRADE_AND_PUSH_RIGHT\",\n                            \"谓词引用 NULL 补充侧（右表）列且拒绝 NULL：右列补 NULL Plan.InnerJoin(nl, nr, on);\n            d.add(new Decision(\"*\", \"CONVERT_LEFT_TO_INNER\",\n                    \"存在引用右表且拒绝 NULL 的谓词：左外连接的保留行不可能存活，\"\n                            + \"将 LeftJoin 改写为 ppd;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 把计划树序列化为可读 JSON（用于导出执行计划）。 */\npublic final class PlanExplain {\n\n    private PlanExplain() {}\n\n    public static Map<String, Object> toJson(Plan p) {\n        return switch (p) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> {\n                Map<String, Object> m = base(\"Scan\", s);\n                m.put(\"table\", s.table());\n                yield m;\n            }\n            case Plan.Filter f -> {\n                Map<String, Object> m = base(\"Filter\", f);\n                m.put(\"predicate\", f.predicate().toSql());\n                m.put(\"child\", toJson(f.child()));\n                yield m;\n            }\n            case Plan.Project pr -> {\n                Map<String, Object> m = base(\"Project\", pr);\n                m.put(\"items\", pr.items().stream().map(Expr::toSql).toList());\n                m.put(\"child\", toJson(pr.child()));\n                yield m;\n            }\n            case Plan.InnerJoin ij -> {\n                Map<String, Object> m = base(\"InnerJoin\", ij);\n                m.put(\"joinType\", \"inner\");\n                m.put(\"on\", ij.onPredicates().stream().map(Expr::toSql).toList());\n                m.put(\"left\", toJson(ij.left()));\n                m.put(\"right\", toJson(ij.right()));\n                yield m;\n            }\n            case Plan.LeftJoin lj -> {\n                Map<String, Object> m = base(\"LeftJoin\", lj);\n                m.put(\"joinType\", \"left\");\n                m.put(\"on\", lj.onPredicates().stream().map(Expr::toSql).toList());\n                m.put(\"left\", toJson(lj.left()));\n                m.put(\"right\", toJson(lj.right()));\n                yield m;\n            }\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> base(String op, Plan p) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"op\", op);\n        m.put(\"outputColumns\", describeSchema(p.schema()));\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    /** 带 nullable 标记与列来源的 schema 描述。 */\n    public static List<Map<String, Object>> describeSchema(Schema s) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Column c : s.columns()) {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"name\", c.display());\n            m.put(\"nullable\", c.nullable());\n            if (c.origin() != null) {\n                Column r = c.rootOrigin();\n                m.put(\"origin\", r.display());\n            }\n            out.add(m);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    /** 缩进文本形式。 */\n    public static String toText(Plan p) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n        print(sb, p, 0);\n        return sb.toString();\n    }\n\n    private static void print(StringBuilder sb, Plan p, int depth) {\n        sb.append(\"  \".repeat(depth));\n        switch (p) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> sb.append(\"Scan(\").append(s.table()).append(\")\\n\");\n            case Plan.Filter f -> {\n                sb.append(\"Filter(\").append(f.predicate().toSql()).append(\")\\n\");\n                print(sb, f.child(), depth + 1);\n            }\n            case Plan.Project pr -> {\n {"parentUuid":"c619dd10-ed3c-4a01-a66b-2444651d1005","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_9kniql058gyxebhg2sd8f9le","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a/src/ppd/QueryEngine.java","content":"package ppd;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 查询引擎门面：接收 JSON 请求 -> 解析表与计划 -> 下推改写 -> 执行，\n * 返回含改写理由、前后计划与结果的 JSON 响应。\n *\n * <p>请求格式见 samples/。核心运算全部由本包自行实现，不依赖任何 SQL 引擎。</p>\n */\npublic class QueryEngine {\n\n    public record Response(boolean ok, Object payload, String error) {\n        public Map<String, Object> toJson() {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"ok\", ok);\n            if (ok) m.put(\"result\", payload);\n            else m.put(\"error\", error);\n            return m;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Response runJson(String requestJson) {\n        try {\n            Map<String, Object> req = Json.parseObject(requestJson);\n            return new Response(true, run(req), null);\n        } catch (EngineException ex) {\n            return new Response(false, null, ex.getMessage());\n        } catch (Exception ex) {\n            return new Response(false, null,\n                    ex.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + ex.getMessage());\n        }\n    }\n\n    public Map<String, Object> run(Map<String, Object> req) {\n        // 1. 装载基表\n        Map<String, Table> tables = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Map<String, Object> td : Json.getObjList(req, \"tables\")) {\n            Table t = Table.fromJson(td);\n            tables.put(t.qualifier(), t);\n        }\n        // 计划里 scan.table 用的是 name；额外保留 name -> table\n        Map<String, Object> rawTables = Json.getObj(req, \"tables\") == null\n                ? Map.of() : Json.getObj(req, \"tables\");\n        Map<String, Table> byScanName = new LinkedHashMap<>(tables);\n        if (req.get(\"tables\") instanceof List<?> list) {\n            for (Object o : list) {\n                Map<String, Object> td = Json.obj(o);\n                Table t = Table.fromJson(td);\n                byScanName.put(Json.getStr(td, \"name\"), t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 2. 解析原始计划\n        Map<String, Object> planJson = Json.getObj(req, \"plan\");\n        if (planJson == null) throw new EngineException(\"缺少 plan 字段\");\n        Plan original = Plan.fromJson(planJson, byScanName);\n\n        // 3. 谓词下推改写\n        PushdownRewriter rewriter = new PushdownRewriter();\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr = rewriter.rewrite(original);\n\n        // 4. 执行改写前 / 改写后\n        Executor exec = new Executor();\n        List<Row> rowsBefore = exec.execute(original);\n        List<Row> rowsAfter = exec.execute(rr.plan());\n        Schema out = rr.plan().schema();\n\n        // 5. 组装响应\n        Map<String, Object> result = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        result.put(\"equivalent\", bagEquals(rowsBefore, rowsAfter));\n        result.put(\"rowCountBefore\", rowsBefore.size());\n        result.put(\"rowCountAfter\", rowsAfter.size());\n\n        result.put(\"planBefore\", PlanExplain.toJson(original));\n        result.put(\"planAfter\", PlanExplain.toJson(rr.plan()));\n        result.put(\"planBeforeText\", PlanExplain.toText(original).stripTrailing());\n        result.put(\"planAfterText\", PlanExplain.toText(rr.plan()).stripTrailing());\n\n        List<Map<String, Object>> decisions = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (PushdownRewriter.Decision d : rr.decisions()) decisions.add(d.toJson());\n        result.put(\"rewriteDecisions\", decisions);\n\n        result.put(\"outputColumns\", out.display());\n        result.put(\"rowsBefore\", rowsToJson(rowsBefore, out));\n        result.put(\"rowsAfter\", rowsToJson(rowsAfter, out));\n\n        boolean exportData = Json.getBool(req, \"exportData\", true);\n        if (exportData) {\n            result.put(\"dataExport\", exportData(tables, original, rr, rowsBefore, rowsAfter));\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> exportData(Map<String, Table> tables,\n                                           Plan original,\n                                           PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr,\n                                           List<Row> before, List<Row> after) {\n        Map<String, Object> exp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        // 数据\n        List<Map<String, Object>> ts = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Table t : tables.values()) {\n            Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            m.put(\"name\", t.qualifier());\n            m.put(\"columns\", t.columnNames());\n            List<Object> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row r : t.rows()) rows.add(r.toList());\n            m.put(\"rows\", rows);\n            ts.add(m);\n        }\n        exp.put(\"tables\", ts);\n        // 执行计划\n        exp.put(\"planBefore\", PlanExplain.toJson(original));\n        exp.put(\"planAfter\", PlanExplain.toJson(rr.plan()));\n        return exp;\n    }\n\n    private List<Map<String, Object>> rowsToJson(List<Row> rows, Schema schema) {\n        List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) out.add(r.toNamedMap(schema));\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    /** 包语义比较（多重集相等）。 */\n    public static boolean bagEquals(List<Row> a, List<Row> b) {\n        if (a.size() != b.size()) return false;\n        List<Row> copy = new ArrayList<>(b);\n        for (Row r : a) {\n            int idx = copy.indexOf(r);\n            if (idx < 0) return false;\n            copy.remove(idx);\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_acbb6f13d0600ec04fea0c6c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1858,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":67384,"output_tokens":1517,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_9kniql058gyxebhg2sd8f9le":{"content":"package i < args.length; i++) {\n            if (\"--export\".equals(args[i])) {\n                exportPath = args[++i];\n            } else {\n                inputPath = args[i];\n            }\n        }\n\n        String request;\n        if (inputPath != null) {\n            request = Files.readString(Path.of(inputPath), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        } else {\n            request = new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        }\n\n        QueryEngine engine = new QueryEngine();\n        QueryEngine.Response resp = engine.runJson(request);\n        String out = Json.renderPretty(resp.toJson());\n        System.out.println(out);\n\n        if (exportPath != null && resp.ok()) {\n            java.util.Map<?, ?> r = Json.obj(resp.payload());\n            Object dataExport = r.get(\"dataExport\");\n            Files.writeString(Path.of(exportPath),\n                    Json.renderPretty(dataExport), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            System.err.println(\"[export] 数据与执行计划已导出到 \" + exportPath);\n        }\n\n        if (!resp.ok()) System.exit(1);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0eed8f8f-c96a-471e-a895-b6b4dd839c0f","session_id":"fa31553d-768a-4535-ac88-dd4c0130d15b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a","sessionId":"fa31553d-768a-4535-ac88-dd4c0130d15b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp14-a","slug":"witty-herding-iverson"}

* 单机内存执行器：对计划树做实际求值。\n *\n * <ul>\n *   <li>Scan   —— 直接返回基表行；</li>\n *   <li>Filter —— 谓词三值逻辑，仅 TRUE 放行（FALSE/UNKNOWN 都丢弃）；</li>\n *   <li>Project—— 逐项求值（包括算术表达式）；</li>\n *   <li>Join   —— 嵌套循环 + 笛卡尔积按 ON 过滤；左连接不匹配补全 NULL 行。</li>\n * </ul>\n */\npublic class Executor {\n\n    public List<Row> execute(Plan plan) {\n        return switch (plan) {\n            case Plan.Scan s -> new ArrayList<>(s.tableData().rows());\n            case Plan.Filter f -> execFilter(f);\n            case Plan.Project p -> execProject(p);\n            case Plan.InnerJoin j -> execInner(j);\n            case Plan.LeftJoin j -> execLeft(j);\n        };\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execFilter(Plan.Filter f) {\n        Schema in = f.child().schema();\n        List<Row> rows = execute(f.child());\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Object v = f.predicate().eval(envFor(r, in));\n            if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(v)) out.add(r);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execProject(Plan.Project p) {\n        Schema in = p.child().schema();\n        List<Row> rows = execute(p.child());\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Expr.Env env = envFor(r, in);\n            Row nr = new Row(p.items().size());\n            for (int i = 0; i < p.items().size(); i++) {\n                nr.set(i, p.items().get(i).eval(env));\n            }\n            out.add(nr);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execInner(Plan.InnerJoin j) {\n        List<Row> ls = execute(j.left());\n        List<Row> rs = execute(j.right());\n        Schema lsch = j.left().schema();\n        Schema rsch = j.right().schema();\n        Schema joined = j.schema();\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row l : ls) {\n            for (Row r : rs) {\n                Row joinedRow = l.concat(r);\n                if (matchAll(j.onPredicates(), joinedRow, joined)) out.add(joinedRow);\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private List<Row> execLeft(Plan.LeftJoin j) {\n        List<Row> ls = execute(j.left());\n        List<Row> rs = execute(j.right());\n        Schema lsch = j.left().schema();\n        Schema joined = j.schema();\n        List<Row> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row l : ls) {\n            boolean matched = false;\n            for (Row r : rs) {\n                Row joinedRow = l.concat(r);\n                if (matchAll(j.onPredicates(), joinedRow, joined)) {\n                    out.add(joinedRow);\n                    matched = true;\n                }\n            }\n            if (!matched) {\n                // 保留行：右表列全部补 NULL\n                out.add(l.concat(Row.nullRow(rsch.size())));\n            }\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private boolean matchAll(List<Expr> predicates, Row row, Schema schema) {\n        Expr.Env env = envFor(row, schema);\n        for (Expr e : predicates) {\n            if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(e.eval(env))) return false;\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 为一行构造求值环境：把列引用解析到行下标。\n     * 限定名精确匹配；裸列名按 schema 解析（歧义由 Schema.resolve 抛错）。\n     */\n    public static Expr.Env envFor(Row row, Schema schema) {\n        Map<RefKey, Integer> qualified = new HashMap<>();\n        Map<String, Integer> bare = new HashMap<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < schema.size(); i++) {\n            Column c = schema.get(i);\n            qualified.put(new RefKey(c.qualifier(), c.name()), i);\n            bare.put(c.name(), i);\n        }\n        return (qualifier, name) -> {\n            Integer idx;\n            if (qualifier != null) {\n                idx = qualified.get(new RefKey(qualifier, name));\n            } else {\n                Column c = schema.resolve(new RefKey(null, name));\n                if (c == null) {\n                    throw new EngineException(\"列不存在: \" + name);\n                }\n                idx = schema.indexOf(c);\n            }\n            if (idx == null) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"列不存在: \" + (qualifier == null ? name : qualifier + \".\" + name));\n            }\n            return row.get(idx);\n        };\n {"parentUuid":"0656ee83-1f90-4614-b827-d2ab9486aeb9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"这里我要修正判定模型：外连接“保留行”的特征是**右侧所有列同时为 NULL**，标准的 NULL 拒绝性测试应把目标列集合整体置为 NULL 求三值结果，而不是逐列“可空”分析。后者在 `(r.b>50) AND (r.b IS NOT NULL)` 这类谓词上不精确。重写为“整组置 NULL”的抽象求值：\n","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_c515317f134d2e41ea189e9b","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":652,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":76600,"output_tokens":2688,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"3ce53fd6-48a4-4395-a131-d45c62561869","timestamp":"2026-09-23T02:52:16.375Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"fa31553d-768a-4535-ac88-dd4c0130d15b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a","sessionId":"fa31553d-768a-4535-ac88-dd4c0130d15b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp14-a","slug":"witty-herding-iverson"}
{"parentUuid":"3ce53fd6-48a4-4395-a131-d45c62561869","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_zhp8g9xs7lknlcpcbyentr3a","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a/src/ppd/Expr.java","old_string":"    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // NULL 拒绝性分析（抽象解释）\n    //\n    // 值的抽象域：\n    //   NULL —— 一定是 NULL\n    //   NN   —— 一定非 NULL\n    //   ANY  —— 可能 NULL 也可能非 NULL\n    // 布尔结果用三比特描述：能否为 T / F / U(=UNKNOWN)。\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    enum Abs { NULL, NN, ANY }\n\n    record Outcome(boolean t, boolean f, boolean u) {\n        static final Outcome T = new Outcome(true, false, false);\n        static final Outcome F = new Outcome(false, true, false);\n        static final Outcome U = new Outcome(false, false, true);\n        static final Outcome TF = new Outcome(true, true, false);\n        static final Outcome TFU = new Outcome(true, true, true);\n        static final Outcome FU = new Outcome(false, true, true);\n        static final Outcome TU = new Outcome(true, false, true);\n\n        Outcome or(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t || o.t, f && o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(t || o.t));\n        }\n\n        Outcome and(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t && o.t, f || o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(f || o.f));\n        }\n\n        Outcome not() { return new Outcome(f, t, u); }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 谓词是否拒绝 NULL：在 nullable 判定为“可能 NULL”的列上，\n     * 若无论其他列取何值，谓词都不可能求值为 TRUE，则返回 true。\n     *\n     * @param nullable 判定一个列引用是否“可能为 NULL”\n     */\n    default boolean isNullRejecting(Predicate<RefKey> nullable) {\n        return !abstractBool(nullable).t();\n    }\n\n    /** 布尔表达式在抽象域上的可能结果集合。 */\n    default Outcome abstractBool(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n        // 默认按“值是否可能为 NULL”粗估；布尔字面量/比较/逻辑节点各自精化。\n        return switch (abstractVal(n)) {\n            case NULL -> Outcome.U;\n            case NN -> Outcome.TF;\n            case ANY -> Outcome.TFU;\n        };\n    }\n\n    /** 标量值在抽象域上的取值。 */\n    Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> nullable);","new_string":"    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // NULL 拒绝性分析（抽象解释）\n    //\n    // 外连接“保留行”的特征：NULL 补充侧的所有列同时为 NULL。\n    // 标准的 NULL 拒绝性测试：把目标列集合整体置为 NULL，其余列视为“某个非空值”，\n    // 求谓词在三值逻辑下是否可能为 TRUE。\n    //\n    // 布尔可能结果用三比特描述：能否为 T / F / U(=UNKNOWN)。\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    record Outcome(boolean t, boolean f, boolean u) {\n        static final Outcome T = new Outcome(true, false, false);\n        static final Outcome F = new Outcome(false, true, false);\n        static final Outcome U = new Outcome(false, false, true);\n        static final Outcome TF = new Outcome(true, true, false);\n        static final Outcome FU = new Outcome(false, true, true);\n\n        Outcome or(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t || o.t, f && o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(t || o.t));\n        }\n\n        Outcome and(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t && o.t, f || o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(f || o.f));\n        }\n\n        Outcome not() { return new Outcome(f, t, u); }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 谓词是否拒绝 NULL：把 {@code nulled} 中的列整体置为 NULL，其余列视为某个非空值\n     * （使其参与的比较可真可假），若谓词在该情形下不可能求值为 TRUE，则返回 true。\n     *\n     * @param nulled 在“保留行”场景下被补 NULL 的列集合\n     */\n    default boolean rejectsNulls(java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        return !nullTestOutcome(nulled).t();\n    }\n\n    /** 列在 NULL 测试中是 NULL 还是“某个非空值”。 */\n    private boolean isNulledRef(Expr.Ref r, java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        if (nulled.contains(r.key())) return true;\n        if (r.qualifier() == null) {\n            // 裸列名：按列名匹配集合内任一限定列\n            for (RefKey k : nulled) {\n                if (k.name().equals(r.name())) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * NULL 测试下布尔表达式的可能结果集合。\n     * 目标列 => 该值为 NULL；其他列 => 非空的未知值（比较可 T 可 F，IS NULL => F）。\n     */\n    default Outcome nullTestOutcome(java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        // 非布尔专用节点的保守默认（Ref/Lit 等在布尔位置时）\n        return booleanDefault(this, nulled);\n    }\n\n    private static Outcome booleanDefault(Expr e, java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        boolean canNull = false;\n        java.util.Set<RefKey> rs = new java.util.HashSet<>();\n        e.collectRefs(rs);\n        for (RefKey k : rs) if (containsAsNulled(k, nulled)) canNull = true;\n        return canNull ? Outcome.FU : Outcome.TF;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean containsAsNulled(RefKey k, java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        if (nulled.contains(k)) return true;\n        if (k.qualifier() == null) {\n            for (RefKey x : nulled) if (x.name().equals(k.name())) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n ppd;\n\nimport java.util.LinkedHashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Set;\nimport java.util.function.Predicate;\n\n/**\n * 标量表达式（谓词）树。\n *\n * 支持：字面量、列引用、六种比较、AND/OR/NOT、IS [NOT] NULL、加减乘。\n * 求值遵循 SQL 三值逻辑（UNKNOWN 用 Java null 表示 Boolean 结果）。\n *\n * 每个表达式还能用抽象解释回答关键问题：\n * {@link #isNullRejecting(Predicate)} —— 当给定列可能为 NULL 时，\n * 该谓词是否“绝不可能为真”（rejects nulls）。这是外连接下推判定的核心。\n */\npublic sealed interface Expr permits Expr.Lit, Expr.Ref, Expr.Cmp, Expr.Logic,\n        Expr.Not, Expr.IsNull, Expr.Arith {\n\n    /** 求值环境：按 限定名.列名 / 裸列名 取当前行的值。 */\n    @FunctionalInterface\n    interface Env {\n        Object lookup(String qualifier, String name);\n    }\n\n    Object eval(Env env);\n\n    /** 收集出现的全部列引用。 */\n    default Set<RefKey> refs() {\n        Set<RefKey> out = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        collectRefs(out);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out);\n\n    /** 规范文本（可被 {@link ExprParser} 再次解析，用于计划 JSON 与测试）。 */\n    String toSql();\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // NULL 拒绝性分析（抽象解释）\n    //\n    // 外连接“保留行”的特征：NULL 补充侧的所有列同时为 NULL。\n    // 标准的 NULL 拒绝性测试：把目标列集合整体置为 NULL，其余列视为“某个非空值”，\n    // 求谓词在三值逻辑下是否可能为 TRUE。\n    //\n    // 布尔可能结果用三比特描述：能否为 T / F / U(=UNKNOWN)。\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    record Outcome(boolean t, boolean f, boolean u) {\n        static final Outcome T = new Outcome(true, false, false);\n        static final Outcome F = new Outcome(false, true, false);\n        static final Outcome U = new Outcome(false, false, true);\n        static final Outcome TF = new Outcome(true, true, false);\n        static final Outcome FU = new Outcome(false, true, true);\n\n        Outcome or(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t || o.t, f && o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(t || o.t));\n        }\n\n        Outcome and(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t && o.t, f || o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(f || o.f));\n        }\n\n        Outcome not() { return new Outcome(f, t, u); }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 谓词是否拒绝 NULL：把 {@code nulled} 中的列整体置为 NULL，其余列视为某个非空值\n     * （使其参与的比较可真可假），若谓词在该情形下不可能求值为 TRUE，则返回 true。\n     *\n     * @param nulled 在“保留行”场景下被补 NULL 的列集合\n     */\n    default boolean rejectsNulls(java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        return !nullTestOutcome(nulled).t();\n    }\n\n    /** 列在 NULL 测试中是 NULL 还是“某个非空值”。 */\n    private boolean isNulledRef(Expr.Ref r, java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        if (nulled.contains(r.key())) return true;\n        if (r.qualifier() == null) {\n            // 裸列名：按列名匹配集合内任一限定列\n            for (RefKey k : nulled) {\n                if (k.name().equals(r.name())) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * NULL 测试下布尔表达式的可能结果集合。\n     * 目标列 => 该值为 NULL；其他列 => 非空的未知值（比较可 T 可 F，IS NULL => F）。\n     */\n    default Outcome nullTestOutcome(java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        // 非布尔专用节点的保守默认（Ref/Lit 等在布尔位置时）\n        return booleanDefault(this, nulled);\n    }\n\n    private static Outcome booleanDefault(Expr e, java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        boolean canNull = false;\n        java.util.Set<RefKey> rs = new java.util.HashSet<>();\n        e.collectRefs(rs);\n        for (RefKey k : rs) if (containsAsNulled(k, nulled)) canNull = true;\n        return canNull ? Outcome.FU : Outcome.TF;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean containsAsNulled(RefKey k, java.util.Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        if (nulled.contains(k)) return true;\n        if (k.qualifier() == null) {\n            for (RefKey x : nulled) if (x.name().equals(k.name())) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 具体节点\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** 字面量：null / Long / Double / String / Boolean。 */\n    record Lit(Object value) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) { return value; }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            return value == null ? Abs.NULL : Abs.NN;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome abstractBool(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            if (value == null) return Outcome.U;\n            if (value instanceof Boolean b) return b ? Outcome.T : Outcome.F;\n            // 非布尔出现在布尔位置时，保守视为 T/F 皆可\n            return Outcome.TF;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() { return litToSql(value); }\n\n        static String litToSql(Object v) {\n            if (v == null) return \"NULL\";\n            if (v instanceof Boolean b) return b ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\";\n            if (v instanceof String s) {\n                return \"'\" + s.replace(\"'\", \"''\") + \"'\";\n            }\n            return v.toString();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 列引用：t.col 或裸 col。 */\n    record Ref(String qualifier, String name) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) { return env.lookup(qualifier, name); }\n\n        public RefKey key() { return new RefKey(qualifier, name); }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { out.add(key()); }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            return n.test(key()) ? Abs.ANY : Abs.NN;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            return qualifier == null ? name : qualifier + \".\" + name;\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum CmpOp {\n        EQ(\"=\"), NE(\"<>\"), LT(\"<\"), LE(\"<=\"), GT(\">\"), GE(\">=\");\n        final String text;\n        CmpOp(String t) { text = t; }\n    }\n\n    record Cmp(CmpOp op, Expr left, Expr right) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            Object a = left.eval(env);\n            Object b = right.eval(env);\n            return switch (op) {\n                case EQ -> Values.eq(a, b);\n                case NE -> {\n                    Boolean r = Values.eq(a, b);\n                    yield r == null ? null : !r;\n                }\n                default -> {\n                    Integer c = Values.compare(a, b);\n                    if (c == null) yield null;\n                    yield switch (op) {\n                        case LT -> c < 0;\n                        case LE -> c <= 0;\n                        case GT -> c > 0;\n                        case GE -> c >= 0;\n                        default -> throw new AssertionError();\n                    };\n                }\n            };\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) {\n            left.collectRefs(out);\n            right.collectRefs(out);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            Abs a = left.abstractVal(n);\n            Abs b = right.abstractVal(n);\n            if (a == Abs.NULL || b == Abs.NULL) return Abs.NULL;\n            if (a == Abs.ANY || b == Abs.ANY) return Abs.ANY;\n            return Abs.NN;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome abstractBool(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            Abs a = left.abstractVal(n);\n            Abs b = right.abstractVal(n);\n            if (a == Abs.NN && b == Abs.NN) {\n                return Outcome.TF;                       // 两个都保证非空：可真可假\n            }\n            if (a == Abs.NULL || b == Abs.NULL) {\n                return Outcome.U;                        // 必空：恒 UNKNOWN\n            }\n            // 至少一侧 ANY（可空可非空），另一侧 NN：非空行可真可假，空行 => UNKNOWN\n            return Outcome.TFU;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            return \"(\" + left.toSql() + \" \" + op.text + \" \" + right.toSql() + \")\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum LogicOp { AND, OR }\n\n    record Logic(LogicOp op, Expr left, Expr right) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            Boolean a = (Boolean) left.eval(env);\n            Boolean b = (Boolean) right.eval(env);\n            return op == LogicOp.AND ? Values.and(a, b) : Values.or(a, b);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) {\n            left.collectRefs(out);\n            right.collectRefs(out);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            Abs a = left.abstractVal(n);\n            Abs b = right.abstractVal(n);\n            if (a == Abs.NULL && b == Abs.NULL) return Abs.NULL;\n            if (a == Abs.NN && b == Abs.NN) return Abs.NN;\n            return Abs.ANY;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome abstractBool(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            Outcome a = left.abstractBool(n);\n            Outcome b = right.abstractBool(n);\n            return op == LogicOp.AND ? a.and(b) : a.or(b);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            String opText = op == LogicOp.AND ? \" AND \" : \" OR \";\n            return \"(\" + left.toSql() + opText + right.toSql() + \")\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    record Not(Expr inner) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            return Values.not((Boolean) inner.eval(env));\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { inner.collectRefs(out); }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) { return inner.abstractVal(n); }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome abstractBool(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            return inner.abstractBool(n).not();\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() { return \"(NOT \" + inner.toSql() + \")\"; }\n    }\n\n    record IsNull(Expr inner, boolean negated) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            boolean isNull = inner.eval(env) == null;\n            return negated != isNull;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { inner.collectRefs(out); }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) { return Abs.NN; }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome abstractBool(Predicate<RefKey> n)
