b);\n            };\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) {\n            left.collectRefs(out);\n            right.collectRefs(out);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Abs abstractVal(Predicate<RefKey> n) {\n            Abs a = left.abstractVal(n);\n            Abs b = right.abstractVal(n);\n            if (a == Abs.NULL || b == Abs.NULL) out);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static void collectConjuncts(Expr e, List<Expr> out) {\n        if (e instanceof Logic(LogicOp op, Expr l, Expr r) && op == LogicOp.AND) {\n            collectConjuncts(l, out);\n            collectConjuncts(r, out);\n        } else {\n            out.add(e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 合取合并；空列表返回常量 TRUE。 */\n    static Expr ppd;\n\nimport java.util.HashSet;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/**\n * 标量表达式（谓词）树。\n *\n * 支持：字面量、列引用、六种比较、AND/OR/NOT、IS [NOT] NULL、加减乘。\n * 求值遵循 SQL 三值逻辑（UNKNOWN 用 Java null 表示 Boolean 结果）。\n *\n * 每个谓词还能用抽象解释回答下推判定的关键问题：\n * {@link #rejectsNulls(Set)} —— 当给定列集合整体为 NULL（模拟外连接保留行），\n * 谓词是否绝不可能求值为 TRUE。\n */\npublic sealed interface Expr permits Expr.Lit, Expr.Ref, Expr.Cmp, Expr.Logic,\n        Expr.Not, Expr.IsNull, Expr.Arith {\n\n    /** 求值环境：按 限定名.列名 / 裸列名 取当前行的值。 */\n    @FunctionalInterface\n    interface Env {\n        Object lookup(String qualifier, String name);\n    }\n\n    Object eval(Env env);\n\n    /** 收集出现的全部列引用。 */\n    default Set<RefKey> refs() {\n        Set<RefKey> out = new LinkedHashSet<>();\n        collectRefs(out);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out);\n\n    /** 规范文本（可被 {@link ExprParser} 再次解析，用于计划 JSON 与测试）。 */\n    String toSql();\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // NULL 拒绝性分析（抽象解释）\n    //\n    // 外连接“保留行”的特征：NULL 补充侧的所有列同时为 NULL。\n    // NULL 拒绝性测试：把目标列集合整体置为 NULL，其余列视为“某个非空的未知值”，\n    // 求谓词在三值逻辑下的可能结果集合（T/F/U 三比特）。\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    record Outcome(boolean t, boolean f, boolean u) {\n        static final Outcome T = new Outcome(true, false, false);\n        static final Outcome F = new Outcome(false, true, false);\n        static final Outcome U = new Outcome(false, false, true);\n        static final Outcome TF = new Outcome(true, true, false);\n        static final Outcome FU = new Outcome(false, true, true);\n\n        Outcome or(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t || o.t, f && o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(t || o.t));\n        }\n\n        Outcome and(Outcome o) {\n            return new Outcome(t && o.t, f || o.f,\n                    (u || o.u) && !(f || o.f));\n        }\n\n        Outcome not() { return new Outcome(f, t, u); }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 谓词是否拒绝 NULL：把 {@code nulled} 中的列整体置为 NULL，其余列视为某个非空值\n     * （使其参与的比较可真可假），若谓词在该情形下不可能求值为 TRUE，则返回 true。\n     *\n     * @param nulled 在“保留行”场景下被补 NULL 的列集合\n     */\n    default boolean rejectsNulls(Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        return !nullTestOutcome(nulled).t();\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * NULL 测试下布尔表达式的可能结果集合。\n     * 目标列 => 该值为 NULL；其他列 => 非空未知值（比较可 T 可 F，IS NULL => F）。\n     */\n    Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> nulled);\n\n    /** 标量子表达式在 NULL 测试中是否必为 NULL。 */\n    boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> nulled);\n\n    /** 引用是否落在被置 NULL 的集合中（裸列名按列名匹配集合内任一列）。 */\n    static boolean refIsNulled(RefKey k, Set<RefKey> nulled) {\n        if (nulled.contains(k)) return true;\n        if (k.qualifier() == null) {\n            for (RefKey x : nulled) {\n                if (x.name().equals(k.name())) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 具体节点\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** 字面量：null / Long / Double / String / Boolean。 */\n    record Lit(Object value) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) { return value; }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) { return value == null; }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            if (value == null) return Outcome.U;\n            if (value instanceof Boolean b) return b ? Outcome.T : Outcome.F;\n            return Outcome.TF; // 非布尔出现在布尔位置：保守视为可真可假\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() { return litToSql(value); }\n\n        static String litToSql(Object v) {\n            if (v == null) return \"NULL\";\n            if (v instanceof Boolean b) return b ? \"TRUE\" : \"FALSE\";\n            if (v instanceof String s) {\n                return \"'\" + s.replace(\"'\", \"''\") + \"'\";\n            }\n            return v.toString();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 列引用：t.col 或裸 col。 */\n    record Ref(String qualifier, String name) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) { return env.lookup(qualifier, name); }\n\n        public RefKey key() { return new RefKey(qualifier, name); }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { out.add(key()); }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            return refIsNulled(key(), n);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            return isNullUnderTest(n) ? Outcome.U : Outcome.TF;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            return qualifier == null ? name : qualifier + \".\" + name;\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum CmpOp {\n        EQ(\"=\"), NE(\"<>\"), LT(\"<\"), LE(\"<=\"), GT(\">\"), GE(\">=\");\n        final String text;\n        CmpOp(String t) { text = t; }\n    }\n\n    record Cmp(CmpOp op, Expr left, Expr right) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            Object a = left.eval(env);\n            Object b = right.eval(env);\n            return switch (op) {\n                case EQ -> Values.eq(a, b);\n                case NE -> {\n                    Boolean r = Values.eq(a, b);\n                    yield r == null ? null : !r;\n                }\n                default -> {\n                    Integer c = Values.compare(a, b);\n                    if (c == null) yield null;\n                    yield switch (op) {\n                        case LT -> c < 0;\n                        case LE -> c <= 0;\n                        case GT -> c > 0;\n                        case GE -> c >= 0;\n                        default -> throw new AssertionError();\n                    };\n                }\n            };\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) {\n            left.collectRefs(out);\n            right.collectRefs(out);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            return left.isNullUnderTest(n) || right.isNullUnderTest(n);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            if (isNullUnderTest(n)) return Outcome.U;   // 任一操作数为 NULL => UNKNOWN\n            return Outcome.TF;                          // 两侧都是非空未知值：可真可假\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            return \"(\" + left.toSql() + \" \" + op.text + \" \" + right.toSql() + \")\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum LogicOp { AND, OR }\n\n    record Logic(LogicOp op, Expr left, Expr right) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            Boolean a = (Boolean) left.eval(env);\n            Boolean b = (Boolean) right.eval(env);\n            return op == LogicOp.AND ? Values.and(a, b) : Values.or(a, b);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) {\n            left.collectRefs(out);\n            right.collectRefs(out);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            boolean a = left.isNullUnderTest(n);\n            boolean b = right.isNullUnderTest(n);\n            return op == LogicOp.AND ? a && b : a || b;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            Outcome a = left.nullTestOutcome(n);\n            Outcome b = right.nullTestOutcome(n);\n            return op == LogicOp.AND ? a.and(b) : a.or(b);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            String opText = op == LogicOp.AND ? \" AND \" : \" OR \";\n            return \"(\" + left.toSql() + opText + right.toSql() + \")\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    record Not(Expr inner) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            return Values.not((Boolean) inner.eval(env));\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { inner.collectRefs(out); }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) { return inner.isNullUnderTest(n); }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            return inner.nullTestOutcome(n).not();\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() { return \"(NOT \" + inner.toSql() + \")\"; }\n    }\n\n    record IsNull(Expr inner, boolean negated) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            boolean isNull = inner.eval(env) == null;\n            return negated != isNull;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) { inner.collectRefs(out); }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) { return false; } // IS NULL 永不为 NULL\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            if (inner.isNullUnderTest(n)) {\n                // 内层必为 NULL：IS NULL => 恒 TRUE；IS NOT NULL => 恒 FALSE\n                return negated ? Outcome.F : Outcome.T;\n            }\n            // 内层是非空未知值（该测试模型下它不会为 NULL）\n            return negated ? Outcome.T : Outcome.F;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            return \"(\" + inner.toSql() + (negated ? \" IS NOT NULL)\" : \" IS NULL)\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum ArithOp { ADD, SUB, MUL }\n\n    record Arith(ArithOp op, Expr left, Expr right) implements Expr {\n        @Override\n        public Object eval(Env env) {\n            Object a = left.eval(env);\n            Object b = right.eval(env);\n            return switch (op) {\n                case ADD -> Values.add(a, b);\n                case SUB -> Values.subtract(a, b);\n                case MUL -> Values.multiply(a, b);\n            };\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public void collectRefs(Set<RefKey> out) {\n            left.collectRefs(out);\n            right.collectRefs(out);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public boolean isNullUnderTest(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            return left.isNullUnderTest(n) || right.isNullUnderTest(n);\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public Outcome nullTestOutcome(Set<RefKey> n) {\n            return isNullUnderTest(n) ? Outcome.U : Outcome.TF;\n        }\n\n        @Override\n        public String toSql() {\n            String opText = switch (op) {\n                case ADD -> \"+\";\n                case SUB -> \"-\";\n                case MUL -> \"*\";\n            };\n            return \"(\" + left.toSql() + \" \" + opText + \" \" + right.toSql() + \")\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 通用变换辅助\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    /** 用映射替换列引用（投影下推时把输出列名换成底层来源列）。 */\n    default Expr mapRefs(java.util.function.Function<Ref, Expr> f) {\n        return ExprMapper.apply(this, f);\n    }\n\n    /** 合取拆分：AND 树拆为列表。 */\n    static List<Expr> splitConjunction(Expr e) {\n        List<Expr> out = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        collectConjuncts(e, out);\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static void collectConjuncts(Expr e, List<Expr> out) {\n        if (e instanceof Logic(LogicOp op, Expr l, Expr r) && op == LogicOp.AND) {\n            collectConjuncts(l, out);\n            collectConjuncts(r, out);\n        } else {\n            out.add(e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 合取合并；空列表返回常量 TRUE。 */\n    static Expr combineConjunction(List<Expr> es) {\n        if (es.isEmpty()) return new Lit(Boolean.TRUE);\n        Expr result = es.get(0);\n        for (int i = 1; i < es.size(); i++) {\n            result = new Logic(LogicOp.AND, result, es.get(i));\n        }\n        return result;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_82de8b9145635296d7490a6c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":5691,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":3461,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_urfozovljbb9wufgkmspkyv0":{"content":"package Project(items, child)            items 至少保持列来源追踪\n *         | InnerJoin(left, right, onPredicates)\n *         | LeftJoin(left, right, onPredicates)   左表为保留侧\n * </pre>\n *\n * schema 由结构推导；列来源用 schema() { return tableData.schema(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Scan\"; }\n 为输出列表达式；simpleOrigin 非空表示该输出是对底层某列的简单引用\n     * （用于列来源追踪与谓词下推）。\n     */\n    final class Project implements Plan {\n        private final List<Expr> items;\n        private final Plan child;\n        private final Schema schema;\n\n        public Project(List<Expr> items, Plan child) {\n            this.items = List.copyOf(items);\n            this.child = child;\n            List<Column> out = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Expr e : items) {\n                Column c = columnFor(e, child.schema());\n                out.add(c);\n            }\n            this.schema = new Schema(out);\n        }\n\n        private static Column columnFor(Expr e, Schema input) {\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Ref r) {\n                Column src = input.resolve(r.key());\n                if (src == null) {\n                    throw new EngineException(\"投影引用了不存在的列: \" + r.key());\n                }\n                // 输出列的身份沿用底层列（限定名、列名），仅通过 origin 保持来源链；\n                // 这样投影之后仍可用 t.col 消歧重名列。\n                return new Column(src.qualifier(), src.name(), src.nullable(), src);\n            }\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Lit l) {\n                return new Column(null, \"const\", l.value() == null, null);\n            }\n            if (e instanceof Expr.Arith a) {\n                boolean nullable = a.abstractVal(k -> {\n                    Column c = @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return schema; }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(child); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"Project\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 内连接。 */\n    record InnerJoin(Plan left, Plan right, List<Expr> onPredicates) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() { return joinSchema(left, right); }\n\n        @Override\n        public List<Plan> children() { return List.of(left, right); }\n\n        @Override\n        public String typeName() { return \"InnerJoin\"; }\n    }\n\n    /** 左外连接：左表为保留侧，右表列在结果上可能为 NULL。 */\n    record LeftJoin(Plan left, Plan right, List<Expr> onPredicates) implements Plan {\n        @Override\n        public Schema schema() {\n            Schema base = joinSchema(left, right);\n            // 右表列（可能因不匹配被补 NULL）：全部标记 nullable\n            int split = left.schema().size();\n            List<Column> cols = new 谓词表达式解析器（递归下降，无第三方依赖）。\n *\n * 文法（优先级从低到高）：\n *   or     := and ( OR and )*\n *   and    := not ( AND not )*\n *   not    := NOT not | cmp\n *   cmp    := add [ (= &lt;&gt; &lt; &lt;= &gt; &gt;= ) add | IS [NOT] NULL ]\n *   add    := mul ( (+ | -) mul )*\n *   mul    := atom ( * atom )*\n *   atom   := 字面量 | 列引用 | '(' or ')'\n *\n * 字面量：NULL/TRUE/FALSE、整数、小数、'单引号字符串'（'' 转义）。\n * 列引用：col 或 alias.col；可用双引号包裹标识符。\n */\npublic final class ExprParser {\n\n    private final List<Token> tokens;\n    private int pos;\n\n    private ExprParser(List<Token> tokens) {\n        this.tokens = EngineException(\"谓词存在多余 token: \" + p.peek().text);\n        return e;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 递归下降\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n        while (matchKeyword(\"OR\")) {\n            left = new Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp.OR, left, parseAnd());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAnd() {\n        Expr left = parseNot();\n        while (matchKeyword(\"AND\")) {\n            left = new Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp.AND, left, parseNot());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (matchKeyword(\"NOT\")) {\n            return new Expr.Not(parseNot());\n        }\n        return parseCmp();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseCmp() {\n        Expr left = parseAdd();\n        if (matchKeyword(\"IS\")) {\n            boolean negated = matchKeyword(\"NOT\");\n            requireKeyword(\"NULL\");\n            return new Expr.IsNull(left, negated);\n        }\n        if (peek().type == TokenType.OP) {\n            String op = advance().text;\n            Expr right = parseAdd();\n            Expr.CmpOp cmp = switch (op) {\n                case \"=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.EQ;\n                case \"<>\" -> Expr.CmpOp.NE;\n                case \"!=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.NE;\n                case \"<\" -> Expr.CmpOp.LT;\n                case \"<=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.LE;\n                case \">\" -> Expr.CmpOp.GT;\n                case \">=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.GE;\n                default -> throw new EngineException(\"未知比较运算符: \" + op);\n            };\n            return new Expr.Cmp(cmp, left, right);\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdd() {\n        Expr left = parseMul();\n        while (true) {\n            if (peek().type == TokenType.OP && \"+\".equals(peek().text)) {\n                advance();\n                left = new Expr.Arith(Expr.ArithOp.ADD, left, parseMul());\n            } else if (peek().type == TokenType.MINUS) {\n                advance();\n                left = new Expr.Arith(Expr.ArithOp.SUB, left, parseMul());\n            } else {\n                return left;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseMul() {\n        Expr left = parseAtom();\n        while (peek().type == TokenType.OP && \"*\".equals(peek().text)) {\n            advance();\n            left = new Expr.Arith(Expr.ArithOp.MUL, left, parseAtom());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAtom() {\n        Token t = peek();\n        if (t.type == TokenType.LPAREN) {\n            advance();\n            Expr e = parseOr();\n            Token close = advance();\n            if (close.type != TokenType.RPAREN) throw new EngineException(\"缺少右括号\");\n            return e;\n        }\n        if (t.type == TokenType.STRING) {\n Double.valueOf(t.text) : Long.valueOf(t.text);\n            return new Expr.Lit(v);\n        }\n        if (t.type == TokenType.IDENT) {\n            advance();\n            String upper = (upper.equals(\"FALSE\")) return new Expr.Lit(Boolean.FALSE);\n            String first = t.text;\n            // 点号分隔的限定列\n            if (peek().type == TokenType.DOT) {\n                advance();\n                Token col = advance();\n                if (col.type != TokenType.IDENT) throw new EngineException(\"'.' 后期望列名\");\n                return new Expr.Ref(first, col.text);\n            }\n            return new Expr.Ref(null, first);\n        }\n        throw new EngineException(\"无法解析的 token: \" + t.text);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // token 工具\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Token peek() { return tokens.get(pos); }\n\n    private Token advance() {\n        Token t = tokens.get(pos);\n        if (tokens.get(pos).type != TokenType.EOF) pos++;\n        return t;\n    }\n\n    private boolean atEnd() {\n        Token t = tokens.get(pos);\n        return t.type == TokenType.EOF;\n    }\n\n    private boolean matchKeyword(String kw) {\n        Token t = peek();\n        if (t.type == TokenType.IDENT && t.text.equalsIgnoreCase(kw)) {\n            advance();\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private void requireKeyword(String kw) {\n        if (!matchKeyword(kw)) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"期望关键字 \" + kw + \"，实际为 \" + peek().text);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 词法\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private enum TokenType { IDENT, NUMBER, STRING, OP, MINUS, DOT, LPAREN, RPAREN, EOF }\n\n    private record Token(TokenType type, String text) {}\n\n    private static List<Token> lex(String s) {\n        List<Token> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        int i = 0;\n        int n = s.length();\n        while (i < n) {\n            char c = s.charAt(i);\n            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) { i++; continue; }\n            switch (c) {\n                case '(' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.LPAREN, \"(\")); i++; }\n                case ')' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.RPAREN, \")\")); i++; }\n                case        i++;\n                    while (true) {\n                        if (i >= n) throw new EngineException(\"字符串未闭合\");\n                        char ch = s.charAt(i);\n                        if (ch == '\\'') {\n                            if (i + 1 < n && s.charAt(i + 1) == '\\'') {\n                                sb.append('\\'');\n                                i += 2;\n cmp    := add [ (= &lt;&gt; &lt; &lt;= &gt; &gt;= ) add | IS [NOT] NULL ]\n *   add    := mul ( (+ | -) mul )*\n *   mul    := atom ( * atom )*\n *   atom   := 字面量 | 列引用 | '(' or ')'\n *\n * 字面量：NULL/TRUE/FALSE、整数、小数、'单引号字符串'（'' 转义）。\n * 列引用：col 或 alias.col；可用双引号包裹标识符。\n */\npublic final class ExprParser {\n\n    private final List<Token> tokens;\n    private int pos;\n\n    private ExprParser(List<Token> tokens) {\n        this.tokens = tokens;\n    }\n\n    public static Expr parse(String text) {\n        ExprParser p = new ExprParser(lex(text));\n        Expr e = p.parseOr();\n        if (!p.atEnd()) throw new EngineException(\"谓词存在多余 token: \" + p.peek().text);\n        return e;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 递归下降\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Expr parseOr() {\n        Expr left = parseAnd();\n        while (matchKeyword(\"OR\")) {\n            left = new Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp.OR, left, parseAnd());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAnd() {\n        Expr left = parseNot();\n        while (matchKeyword(\"AND\")) {\n            left = new Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp.AND, left, parseNot());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseNot() {\n        if (matchKeyword(\"NOT\")) {\n            return new Expr.Not(parseNot());\n        }\n        return parseCmp();\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseCmp() {\n        Expr left = parseAdd();\n        if (matchKeyword(\"IS\")) {\n            boolean negated = matchKeyword(\"NOT\");\n            requireKeyword(\"NULL\");\n            return new Expr.IsNull(left, negated);\n        }\n        if (peek().type == TokenType.OP) {\n            String op = advance().text;\n            Expr right = parseAdd();\n            Expr.CmpOp cmp = switch (op) {\n                case \"=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.EQ;\n                case \"<>\" -> Expr.CmpOp.NE;\n                case \"!=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.NE;\n                case \"<\" -> Expr.CmpOp.LT;\n                case \"<=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.LE;\n                case \">\" -> Expr.CmpOp.GT;\n                case \">=\" -> Expr.CmpOp.GE;\n                default -> throw new EngineException(\"未知比较运算符: \" + op);\n            };\n            return new Expr.Cmp(cmp, left, right);\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAdd() {\n        Expr left = parseMul();\n        while (true) {\n            if (peek().type == TokenType.OP && \"+\".equals(peek().text)) {\n                advance();\n                left = new Expr.Arith(Expr.ArithOp.ADD, left, parseMul());\n            } else if (peek().type == TokenType.MINUS) {\n                advance();\n                left = new Expr.Arith(Expr.ArithOp.SUB, left, parseMul());\n            } else {\n                return left;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseMul() {\n        Expr left = parseAtom();\n        while (peek().type == TokenType.OP && \"*\".equals(peek().text)) {\n            advance();\n            left = new Expr.Arith(Expr.ArithOp.MUL, left, parseAtom());\n        }\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    private Expr parseAtom() {\n        Token t = peek();\n        if (t.type == TokenType.LPAREN) {\n            advance();\n            Expr e = parseOr();\n            Token close = advance();\n            if (close.type != TokenType.RPAREN) throw new (t.type == TokenType.NUMBER) {\n            advance();\n            Object v = t.text.contains(\".\") ? Double.valueOf(t.text) : Long.valueOf(t.text);\n            return new Expr.Lit(v);\n        }        if (t.type == TokenType.IDENT) {\n            advance();\n            String upper = t.text.toUpperCase();\n            if (upper.equals(\"NULL\")) return new Expr.Lit(null);\n            if (upper.equals(\"TRUE\")) return new Expr.Lit(Boolean.TRUE);\n            if (upper.equals(\"FALSE\")) return new Expr.Lit(Boolean.FALSE);\n            String first = t.text;\n            // 点号分隔的限定列\n            if (peek().type == TokenType.DOT) {\n                advance();\n                Token col = advance();\n                if (col.type != TokenType.IDENT) throw new EngineException(\"'.' 后期望列名\");\n                return new Expr.Ref(first, col.text);\n ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // token 工具\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private Token peek() { return tokens.get(pos); }\n\n    private Token advance() {\n        Token t = tokens.get(pos);\n        if (tokens.get(pos).type != TokenType.EOF) pos++;\n        return t;\n    }\n\n    private boolean atEnd() {\n        Token t = tokens.get(pos);\n        return t.type == TokenType.EOF;\n    }\n\n    private boolean matchKeyword(String kw) {\n        Token t = peek();\n        if (t.type == TokenType.IDENT && t.text.equalsIgnoreCase(kw)) {\n            advance();\n            return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private void requireKeyword(String kw) {\n        if (!matchKeyword(kw)) {\n            throw new EngineException(\"期望关键字 \" + kw + \"，实际为 \" + peek().text);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 词法\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private enum TokenType { IDENT, NUMBER, STRING, OP, MINUS, DOT, LPAREN, RPAREN, EOF }\n\n    private record Token(TokenType type, String text) {}\n\n    private static List<Token> lex(String s) {\n        List<Token> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        int i = 0;\n        int n = s.length();\n        while (i < n) {\n            char c = s.charAt(i);\n            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) { i++; continue; }\n            switch (c) {\n                case '(' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.LPAREN, \"(\")); i++; }\n                case ')' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.RPAREN, \")\")); i++; }\n                case '.' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.DOT, \".\")); i++; }\n                case '*' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.OP, \"*\")); i++; }\n                case '+' -> { out.add(new Token(TokenType.OP, \"+\")); i++; }\n                case '-' -> {\n                    if (i + 1 < n && s.charAt(i + 1) == '-') { i += 2; continue; }\n                    out.add(new Token(TokenType.MINUS, \"-\"));\n                    i++;\n                }\n                case '=', '<', '>', '!' -> {\n                    if (i + 1 < n && (s.charAt(i + 1) == '=' || s.charAt(i + 1) == '>')) {\n String.valueOf(c)));\n                        i++;\n                    }\n                }\n                case '\\'' -> {\n                    StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();\n sb.append(ch);\n                            i++;\n                        }\n                    }\n                    out.add(new Token(TokenType.STRING, sb.toString()));\n                }\n       int start = i;\n                        while (i < n && Character.isDigit(s.charAt(i))) i++;\n                        if (i < n && s.charAt(i) == '.') {\n                            i++;\n Token(TokenType.IDENT, s.substring(start, i)));\n                    } else {\n                        throw new EngineException(\"非法字符: \" + c);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.add(new Token(TokenType.EOF, \"\"));\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean isIdentStart(char c) {\n        return Character.isLetter(c) || c == '_';\n {"parentUuid":"1433501e-9582-4b4b-88fe-64adf50440ca","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_wlpv1bu7gdg4sx4gdkh3fcrm","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a/test/ppd/tests/ExprTest.java","content":"package ppd.tests;\n\nimport ppd.EngineException;\nimport ppd.Expr;\nimport ppd.ExprParser;\nimport ppd.RefKey;\nimport ppd.Values;\n\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/** 表达式解析、三值逻辑求值与 NULL 拒绝性分析的单元测试。 */\npublic class ExprTest {\n\n    private static Object eval(Expr e, Object rv) {\n        return e.eval((q, n) -> {\n            if (n.equals(\"b\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"r\"))) return rv;\n            if (n.equals(\"a\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"l\"))) return rv;\n            return null;\n        });\n    }\n\n    public static void run(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"表达式：解析与三值逻辑\");\n\n        // 比较的三值逻辑\n        Expr gt = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b > 50\");\n        a.check(\"50<NULL 比较 => UNKNOWN\", eval(gt, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"100>50 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(gt, 100L)));\n        a.check(\"10>50 => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(gt, 10L)));\n\n        Expr eq = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL=1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(eq, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"1=1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(eq, 1L)));\n\n        Expr ne = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b <> 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL<>1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(ne, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"2<>1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(ne, 2L)));\n\n        Expr isnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(isnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(isnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr notnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NOT NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NOT NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NOT NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(notnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr andExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\");\n        a.check(\"AND: UNKNOWN AND FALSE => FALSE\",\n                Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(andExpr, null)));\n        a.check(\"AND: 5 在区间 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(andExpr, 5L)));\n\n        Expr orExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\");\n        a.check(\"OR: NULL OR NULL => UNKNOWN\", eval(orExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"OR: 2 命中 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(orExpr, 2L)));\n\n        Expr notExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"NOT (r.b = 1)\");\n        a.check(\"NOT UNKNOWN => UNKNOWN\", eval(notExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"NOT TRUE => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notExpr, 1L)));\n\n        // 算术与字符串\n        Expr add = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b + 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL+1 => NULL\", eval(add, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"41+1 => 42 (Long)\", Long.valueOf(42L).equals(eval(add, 41L)));\n        Expr concat = ExprParser.parse(\"'x' + r.b\");\n        a.check(\"字符串拼接\", \"x1\".equals(eval(concat, 1L)));\n\n        // 解析往返\n        String[] roundTrip = {\n                \"(l.a = r.b)\", \"(r.b IS NOT NULL)\", \"((r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10))\",\n                \"((r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2))\", \"(NOT (r.b = 1))\", \"((r.b + 1) * 2)\"\n        };\n        for (String s : roundTrip) {\n            Expr e = ExprParser.parse(s);\n            Expr again = ExprParser.parse(e.toSql());\n            a.check(\"往返解析: \" + s, e.toSql().equals(again.toSql()));\n        }\n\n        // 整数不应被解析成浮点\n        Expr litCmp = (Expr.Cmp) gt;\n        a.check(\"整数字面量保持 Long\",\n                ((Expr.Lit) litCmp.right()).value() instanceof Long);\n\n        // 括号与优先级\n        Expr mix = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2 AND r.b > 0\");\n        a.check(\"AND 优先级高于 OR\",\n                mix instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op, Expr l, Expr r)\n                        && op == Expr.LogicOp.OR\n                        && r instanceof {"parentUuid":"0ec78738-e2f6-4780-9cd3-15c25389f789","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_lpn748c8jyswkk9yrxoi3cop","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp14/a/test/ppd/tests/ExecutorTest.java","content":"package ppd.tests;\n\nimport ppd.*;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 执行器与 JSON 入口的功能测试。 */\npublic class ExecutorTest {\n\n    static Table t(String q, List<String> cols, Object[]... rows) {\n        List<Row> rs = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object[] r : rows) rs.add(new Row(java.util.Arrays.asList(r)));\n        return new Table(q, cols, rs);\n    }\n\n    static Plan.Scan scan(String name, Table t) {\n        return new Plan.Scan(name, t);\n    }\n\n    public static void run(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"执行器：扫描/过滤/投影\");\n        Table l = t(\"l\", List.of(\"id\", \"v\"),\n                new Object[]{1L, 10L}, new Object[]{2L, 20L}, new Object[]{3L, null});\n        Table r = t(\"r\", List.of(\"id\", \"w\"),\n                new Object[]{1L, 100L}, new Object[]{2L, null});\n\n        Plan plan = new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"l.v > 15\"), scan(\"l\", l));\n        List<Row> rows = new Executor().execute(plan);\n        a.check(\"过滤仅放行 TRUE（UNKNOWN 丢弃），剩 1 行\", rows.size() == 1);\n        a.check(\"保留 id=2\", rows.get(0).get(0).equals(2L));\n\n        Plan proj = new Plan.Project(\n                List.of(new Expr.Ref(\"l\", \"id\"),\n                        ExprParser.parse(\"l.v + 1\")),\n                scan(\"l\", l));\n        List<Row> pr = new Executor().execute(proj);\n        a.check(\"投影行数不变\", pr.size() == 3);\n        a.check(\"算术投影 10+1=11\", pr.get(0).get(1).equals(11L));\n        a.check(\"NULL 算术 => NULL\", pr.get(2).get(1) == null);\n\n        a.section(\"执行器：内连接 / 左外连接\");\n        Plan inner = new Plan.InnerJoin(scan(\"l\", l), scan(\"r\", r),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n        List<Row> ij = new Executor().execute(inner);\n        a.check(\"内连接命中 2 行\", ij.size() == 2);\n\n        Plan left = new Plan.LeftJoin(scan(\"l\", l), scan(\"r\", r),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n        List<Row> lj = new Executor().execute(left);\n        a.check(\"左连接保留全部 3 行\", lj.size() == 3);\n        a.check(\"未匹配行右表补 NULL\", lj.get(2).get(2) == null && lj.get(2).get(3) == null);\n        a.check(\"右表自身 NULL 值不是补 NULL 行\", lj.get(1).get(2).equals(2L));\n\n        // ON 与 WHERE 在左连接上的差别（关键语义）\n        Plan onFilter = new Plan.LeftJoin(scan(\"l\", l), scan(\"r\", r),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\"),\n                        ExprParser.parse(\"r.w > 150\")));\n        List<Row> onRows = new Executor().execute(onFilter);\n        a.check(\"ON 中右表过滤不删左行（全保留 3 行）\", onRows.size() == 3);\n\n        Plan whereFilter = new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.w > 150\"),\n                new Plan.LeftJoin(scan(\"l\", l), scan(\"r\", r),\n                        List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\"))));\n        List<Row> whereRows = new Executor().execute(whereFilter);\n        a.check(\"WHERE 中右表谓词过滤掉保留行（0 行）\", whereRows.isEmpty());\n\n        a.section(\"JSON 请求入口\");\n        String req = \"\"\"\n                {\n                  \"tables\": [\n                    {\"name\":\"l\",\"columns\":[\"id\",\"v\"],\"rows\":[[1,10],[2,null]]},\n                    {\"name\":\"r\",\"columns\":[\"id\",\"w\"],\"rows\":[[1,100]]}\n                  ],\n                  \"plan\": {\"op\":\"filter\",\"predicate\":\"l.v IS NOT NULL\",\n                    \"child\":{\"op\":\"join\",\"joinType\":\"left\",\"on\":[\"l.id = r.id\"],\n                      \"left\":{\"op\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"l\"},\n                      \"right\":{\"op\":\"scan\",\"table\":\"r\"}}}\n                }\n                \"\"\";\n        QueryEngine.Response resp = new QueryEngine().runJson(req);\n        a.check(\"JSON 请求成功\", resp.ok());\n        if (resp.ok()) {\n            Map<String, Object> res = Json.obj(resp.payload());\n            a.check(\"结果等价标记 true\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(res.get(\"equivalent\")));\n            a.check(\"输出 1 行\", Integer.valueOf(1).equals(res.get(\"rowCountAfter\")));\n        } else {\n            a.fail(\"JSON 请求成功\", resp.error());\n        }\n\n        // 错误：歧义裸列\n        Table dup1 = t(\"t1\", List.of(\"x\"), new Object[]{1L});\n        Table dup2 = t(\"t2\", List.of(\"x\"), new Object[]{1L});\n        Plan dupJoin = new Plan.InnerJoin(scan(\"t1\", dup1), scan(\"t2\", dup2),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"t1.x = t2.x\")));\n        boolean ambig = false;\n        try {\n            new Executor().execute(new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"x = 1\"), dupJoin));\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            ambig = e.getMessage().contains(\"歧义\");\n        }\n        a.check(\"重名列裸引用报歧义错误\", ambig);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_3e30b1234194725e65198622","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2398,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":95032,"output_tokens":1487,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_lpn748c8jyswkk9yrxoi3cop":{"content":"package ppd.tests;\n\nimport ppd.*;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 验收核心：小表穷举比较改写前/后结果。\n *\n * 两张 2 行小表，每个单元格取 {NULL, 1, 2} => 每张表 3^4=81 种取值，\n * 在所有数据库上执行多类谓词 × 内/左连接 × 投影，逐行（包语义）比较改写前后结果。\n * 重点覆盖：右表 NULL 过滤、重名列、常量 FALSE 谓词、投影穿透/阻断。\n */\npublic class ExhaustiveTest {\n\n    private static final Object[] DOMAIN = {null, 1L, 2L};\n\n    public static void run(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"穷举：生成小表数据库（3^4 × 3^4 = 6561 个库）\");\n        List<Table> ls = databases(\"l\");\n        List<Table> rs = databases(\"r\");\n        a.check(\"左表枚举 81 种\", ls.size() == 81);\n        a.check(\"右表枚举 81 种\", rs.size() == 81);\n\n        String[] leftPredicates = {\n                \"l.a = 1\",                       // 保留侧：下推左\n                \"r.b = 1\",                       // NULL 补充侧拒绝 NULL：降级+下推\n                \"r.b IS NULL\",                   // 非拒绝：必须保留在上方\n                \"r.b IS NOT NULL\",               // 拒绝：降级+下推\n                \"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b IS NULL)\",    // 保留行可满足：必须留在上方\n                \"FALSE\",                         // 常量假：只能落保留侧\n                \"l.a = r.b\",                     // 跨两侧且拒绝右 NULL：降级并入 ON\n                \"(l.a = 1) AND (r.b IS NULL)\",   // 混合：左侧下推 + 右侧留上\n                \"(r.b = 1) OR (l.a = 2)\",        // 跨两侧 OR；右 NULL 时可能由左列为真\n                \"l.a IS NOT NULL AND r.b = 1\",   // 合取：左拒绝 + 右拒绝 => 降级\n                \"r.b + 1 > 1\",                   // 算术比较，右 NULL => UNKNOWN：拒绝\n                \"NOT (r.b = 1)\",                 // UNKNOWN 取反仍 UNKNOWN：拒绝\n        };\n\n        String[] innerPredicates = {\n                \"l.a = 1\", \"r.b = 1\", \"l.a = r.b\",\n                \"FALSE\", \"(l.a = 1) AND (r.b = 2)\", \"r.b IS NULL\",\n        };\n\n        long comparisons = 0;\n        long mismatches = 0;\n        List<String> mismatchDetails = new ArrayList<>();\n\n        for (Table l : ls) {\n            for (Table r : rs) {\n                Plan.Scan sl = new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l);\n                Plan.Scan sr = new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r);\n\n                for (String p : leftPredicates) {\n                    Plan lj = new Plan.LeftJoin(sl, sr,\n                            List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n                    comparisons++;\n                    if (!compareRewrite(a, \"LJ \" + p, new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(p), lj),\n                            false, mismatchDetails)) {\n                        mismatches++;\n                    }\n                }\n                for (String p : innerPredicates) {\n                    Plan ij = new Plan.InnerJoin(sl, sr,\n                            List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n                    comparisons++;\n                    if (!compareRewrite(a, \"IJ \" + p, new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(p), ij),\n                            false, mismatchDetails)) {\n                        mismatches++;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // 投影在中间：简单引用 => 应穿透\n                Plan projected = new Plan.Project(\n                        List.of(new Expr.Ref(\"l\", \"id\"), new Expr.Ref(\"l\", \"a\"),\n                                new Expr.Ref(\"r\", \"id\"), new Expr.Ref(\"r\", \"b\")),\n                        new Plan.LeftJoin(sl, sr,\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\"))));\n                comparisons++;\n                if (!compareRewrite(a, \"LJ+Project r.b=1\",\n                        new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\"), projected),\n                        false, mismatchDetails)) {\n                    mismatches++;\n                }\n                comparisons++;\n                if (!compareRewrite(a, \"LJ+Project r.b IS NULL\",\n                        new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\"), projected),\n                        false, mismatchDetails)) {\n                    mismatches++;\n                }\n\n                // 投影含计算列：谓词引用计算列 => 阻断；引用来源列 => 穿透\n                Plan computed = new Plan.Project(\n                        List.of(new Expr.Ref(\"l\", \"id\"), ExprParser.parse(\"l.a + r.b\")),\n                        new Plan.InnerJoin(sl, sr,\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\"))));\n                comparisons++;\n                if (!compareRewrite(a, \"IJ+ComputedProj expr\",\n                        new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"expr > 0\"), computed),\n                        false, mismatchDetails)) {\n                    mismatches++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        System.out.println(\"  共比较 \" + comparisons + \" 个 (数据库 × 查询) 组合，不一致 \" + mismatches + \" 个\");\n        a.check(\"穷举比较总数 = 6561 × 21 = 137781\", comparisons == 6561L * 21L);\n        a.check(\"穷举：改写前后结果全部一致\", mismatches == 0);\n        for (String d : mismatchDetails) a.fail(\"穷举不一致\", d);\n\n        structuralAssertions(a, ls.get(0), rs.get(0));\n        handComputedAssertions(a);\n        duplicateColumnAssertions(a);\n    }\n\n    /** 执行改写前/后并比较；requireChanged 控制是否要求计划确实变化。 */\n    static boolean compareRewrite(Assert a, String label, Plan original,\n                                  boolean requireChanged, List<String> details) {\n        try {\n            PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr = new PushdownRewriter().rewrite(original);\n            Executor exec = new Executor();\n            List<Row> before = exec.execute(original);\n            List<Row> after = exec.execute(rr.plan());\n            boolean eq = QueryEngine.bagEquals(before, after);\n            if (!eq) {\n                details.add(label + \" before=\" + before + \" after=\" + after);\n                return false;\n            }\n            if (requireChanged && rr.plan().equals(original)) {\n                details.add(label + \" 计划未发生改写\");\n                return false;\n            }\n            return true;\n        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {\n            details.add(label + \" 抛异常: \" + ex);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 结构性断言：决策动作符合预期（不只是结果等价）\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void structuralAssertions(Assert a, Table l, Table r) {\n        a.section(\"穷举：改写动作的结构性断言\");\n\n        PushdownRewriter rw = new PushdownRewriter();\n\n        // 1. r.b IS NULL 必须留在左外连接上方\n        Plan p1 = new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\"),\n                new Plan.LeftJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                        List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\"))));\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr1 = rw.rewrite(p1);\n        a.check(\"r.b IS NULL：Filter 仍在 LeftJoin 上方\",\n                rr1.plan() instanceof Plan.Filter f && f.child() instanceof Plan.LeftJoin);\n        a.check(\"决策含 STAY_ABOVE_OUTER_JOIN\",\n                rr1.decisions().stream().anyMatch(d -> d.action().equals(\"STAY_ABOVE_OUTER_JOIN\")));\n\n        // 2. r.b = 1：降级为内连接并下推右表\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr2 = rw.rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\"),\n                        new Plan.LeftJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")))));\n        boolean downgraded = containsNode(rr2.plan(), Plan.InnerJoin.class)\n                && !containsNode(rr2.plan(), Plan.LeftJoin.class);\n        a.check(\"r.b = 1：LeftJoin 被降级为 InnerJoin\", downgraded);\n        a.check(\"r.b = 1：右表下推为 Filter->Scan(r)\",\n                filterOnScan(rr2.plan(), \"r\"));\n\n        // 3. l.a = 1：保留侧下推，LeftJoin 保持不变\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr3 = rw.rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"l.a = 1\"),\n                        new Plan.LeftJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")))));\n        a.check(\"l.a = 1：保留 LeftJoin\", containsNode(rr3.plan(), Plan.LeftJoin.class));\n        a.check(\"l.a = 1：左表下推为 Filter->Scan(l)\",\n                filterOnScan(rr3.plan(), \"l\"));\n\n        // 4. FALSE：落保留侧，LeftJoin 结构保留\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr4 = rw.rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(new Expr.Lit(Boolean.FALSE),\n                        new Plan.LeftJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")))));\n        a.check(\"FALSE：谓词落到左子树（保留侧）\",\n                filterOnScan(rr4.plan(), \"l\")\n                        && containsNode(rr4.plan(), Plan.LeftJoin.class));\n\n        // 5. 内连接跨侧 => 并入 ON\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr5 = rw.rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"l.a = r.b\"),\n                        new Plan.InnerJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")))));\n        boolean merged = rr5.plan() instanceof Plan.InnerJoin ij\n                && ij.onPredicates().size() == 2;\n        a.check(\"内连接跨侧谓词并入 ON\", merged);\n\n        // 6. 计算列阻断投影穿透\n        Plan p6 = new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"expr > 0\"),\n                new Plan.Project(\n                        List.of(new Expr.Ref(\"l\", \"id\"), ExprParser.parse(\"l.a + r.b\")),\n                        new Plan.InnerJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")))));\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr6 = rw.rewrite(p6);\n        a.check(\"计算列谓词保留在 Project 上方\",\n                rr6.plan() instanceof Plan.Filter f && f.child() instanceof Plan.Project);\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 手工小例：直接验证 SQL 真值（不依赖重写器）\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void handComputedAssertions(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"穷举：手工真值用例（WHERE r.b IS NULL 的保留行语义）\");\n        Table l = t(\"l\", List.of(\"id\", \"a\"),\n                new Object[]{1L, 10L}, new Object[]{2L, 20L}, new Object[]{3L, 30L});\n        // r.id=1 的 w 为 NULL；没有 id=3 的右行\n        Table r = t(\"r\", List.of(\"id\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1L, 100L}, new Object[]{2L, null});\n        Plan lj = new Plan.LeftJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n\n        List<Row> isnull = new Executor().execute(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\"), lj));\n        a.check(\"r.b IS NULL 命中 2 行（匹配上的 NULL 值 + 未匹配保留行）\",\n                isnull.size() == 2);\n        a.check(\"第 1 行是 l.id=2（右值本身为 NULL）\", isnull.get(0).get(0).equals(2L));\n        a.check(\"第 2 行是 l.id=3（未匹配补 NULL 保留行）\", isnull.get(1).get(0).equals(3L));\n        a.check(\"保留行右列补 NULL\", isnull.get(1).get(2) == null);\n\n        // 这个谓词若被错误下推到右表（扫描前过滤 r.b IS NULL），结果会只剩 l.id=2，丢掉 l.id=3\n        List<Row> eq1 = new Executor().execute(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\"), lj));\n        a.check(\"r.b = 1 无命中（右表没有 b=1）\", eq1.isEmpty());\n\n        // 穷举重写器在该库上的决策与手工结果一致\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr = new PushdownRewriter().rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\"), lj));\n        List<Row> after = new Executor().execute(rr.plan());\n        a.check(\"重写后仍为 2 行且不丢保留行\", QueryEngine.bagEquals(isnull, after));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 重名列\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static void duplicateColumnAssertions(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"穷举：重名列处理\");\n        Table l = t(\"l\", List.of(\"id\", \"x\"),\n                new Object[]{1L, 1L}, new Object[]{2L, null});\n        Table r = t(\"r\", List.of(\"id\", \"x\"),\n                new Object[]{1L, null}, new Object[]{2L, 2L});\n        Plan join = new Plan.LeftJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n\n        // 限定名分别下推，互不干扰\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr1 = new PushdownRewriter().rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"l.x = 1 AND r.x IS NULL\"), join));\n        List<Row> rows1 = new Executor().execute(rr1.plan());\n        a.check(\"重名列：l.x=1 AND r.x IS NULL => 1 行(l.id=1)\",\n                rows1.size() == 1 && rows1.get(0).get(0).equals(1L));\n        a.check(\"重名列：r.x IS NULL 未被下推（保留行语义）\",\n                rr1.plan() instanceof Plan.Filter f && f.child() instanceof Plan.LeftJoin);\n\n        // 裸列名必须报歧义\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try {\n            new PushdownRewriter().rewrite(\n                    new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"x = 1\"), join));\n        } catch (EngineException e) {\n            threw = e.getMessage().contains(\"歧义\");\n        }\n        a.check(\"重名列裸引用 x 报歧义错误\", threw);\n\n        // 内连接场景：限定名分别下推到左右\n        Plan ij = new Plan.InnerJoin(new Plan.Scan(\"l\", l), new Plan.Scan(\"r\", r),\n                List.of(ExprParser.parse(\"l.id = r.id\")));\n        PushdownRewriter.RewriteResult rr2 = new PushdownRewriter().rewrite(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"l.x = 1 AND r.x = 2\"), ij));\n        List<Row> rows2 = new Executor().execute(rr2.plan());\n        List<Row> expect2 = new Executor().execute(\n                new Plan.Filter(ExprParser.parse(\"l.x = 1 AND r.x = 2\"), ij));\n        a.check(\"重名列内连接：改写前后一致\", QueryEngine.bagEquals(rows2, expect2));\n        a.check(\"重名列内连接：两侧都被下推（无残留 Filter）\",\n                !containsNode(rr2.plan(), Plan.Filter.class));\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private static boolean containsNode(Plan p, Class<?> type) {\n        if (type.isInstance(p)) return true;\n        for (Plan c : p.children()) {\n            if (containsNode(c, type)) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    private static boolean filterOnScan(Plan p, String tableQualifier) {\n        if (p instanceof Plan.Filter f\n                && f.child() instanceof Plan.Scan s\n                && s.tableData().qualifier().equals(tableQualifier)) {\n            return true;\n        }\n        for (Plan c : p.children()) {\n            if (filterOnScan(c, tableQualifier)) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    /** 枚举一张两列两行表的全部 3^4 种取值。 */\n    private static List<Table> databases(String qualifier) {\n        List<Table> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object c0 : DOMAIN)\n            for (Object c1 : DOMAIN)\n                for (Object c2 : DOMAIN)\n                    for (Object c3 : DOMAIN) {\n                        Row r1 = new Row(List.of(c0, c1));\n                        Row r2 = new Row(List.of(c2, c3));\n                        out.add(new Table(qualifier, List.of(\"id\", qualifier.equals(\"l\") ? \"a\" : \"b\"),\n                                List.of(r1, r2)));\n                    }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private static Table t(String q, List<String> cols, Object[]... rows) {\n        return ExecutorTest.t(q, cols, rows);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e98ec627ab05f951028e8af1","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1891,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":97080,"output_tokens":5521,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_c3ba7s4x70hm95q7uoihl85m":{"content":"package ppd.tests;\n\nimport ppd.EngineException;\nimport ppd.Expr;\nimport ppd.ExprParser;\nimport ppd.RefKey;\nimport ppd.Values;\n\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/** 表达式解析、三值逻辑求值与 NULL 拒绝性分析的单元测试。 */\npublic class ExprTest {\n\n    private static Object eval(Expr e, Object rv) {\n        return e.eval((q, n) -> {\n            if (n.equals(\"b\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"r\"))) return rv;\n            if (n.equals(\"a\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"l\"))) return rv;\n            return null;\n        });\n    }\n\n    public static void run(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"表达式：解析与三值逻辑\");\n\n        // 比较的三值逻辑\n        Expr gt = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b > 50\");\n        a.check(\"50<NULL 比较 => UNKNOWN\", eval(gt, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"100>50 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(gt, 100L)));\n        a.check(\"10>50 => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(gt, 10L)));\n\n        Expr eq = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL=1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(eq, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"1=1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(eq, 1L)));\n\n        Expr ne = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b <> 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL<>1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(ne, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"2<>1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(ne, 2L)));\n\n        Expr isnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(isnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(isnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr notnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NOT NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NOT NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NOT NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(notnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr andExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\");\n        a.check(\"AND: UNKNOWN AND FALSE => FALSE\",\n                Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(andExpr, null)));\n        a.check(\"AND: 5 在区间 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(andExpr, 5L)));\n\n        Expr orExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\");\n        a.check(\"OR: NULL OR NULL => UNKNOWN\", eval(orExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"OR: 2 命中 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(orExpr, 2L)));\n\n        Expr notExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"NOT (r.b = 1)\");\n        a.check(\"NOT UNKNOWN => UNKNOWN\", eval(notExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"NOT TRUE => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notExpr, 1L)));\n\n        // 算术与字符串\n        Expr add = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b + 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL+1 => NULL\", eval(add, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"41+1 => 42 (Long)\", Long.valueOf(42L).equals(eval(add, 41L)));\n        Expr concat = ExprParser.parse(\"'x' + r.b\");\n        a.check(\"字符串拼接\", \"x1\".equals(eval(concat, 1L)));\n\n        // 解析往返\n        String[] roundTrip = {\n                \"(l.a = r.b)\", \"(r.b IS NOT NULL)\", \"((r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10))\",\n                \"((r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2))\", \"(NOT (r.b = 1))\", \"((r.b + 1) * 2)\"\n        };\n        for (String s : roundTrip) {\n            Expr e = ExprParser.parse(s);\n            Expr again = ExprParser.parse(e.toSql());\n            a.check(\"往返解析: \" + s, e.toSql().equals(again.toSql()));\n        }\n\n        // 整数不应被解析成浮点\n        Expr litCmp = (Expr.Cmp) gt;\n        a.check(\"整数字面量保持 Long\",\n                ((Expr.Lit) litCmp.right()).value() instanceof Long);\n\n        // 括号与优先级\n        Expr mix = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2 AND r.b > 0\");\n        a.check(\"AND 优先级高于 OR\",\n                mix instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op, Expr l, Expr r)\n                        && op == Expr.LogicOp.OR\n                        && r instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op2, Expr x, Expr y)\n                        && op2 == Expr.LogicOp.AND);\n\n        a.section(\"表达式：NULL 拒绝性判定（保留行模型）\");\n        RefKey rb = new RefKey(\"r\", \"b\");\n        RefKey la = new RefKey(\"l\", \"a\");\n\n        rejects(a, \"r.b > 50\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b = 1\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b <> 1\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b + 1 = 2\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b IS NULL\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b IS NOT NULL\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // 含 IS NULL 的析取：保留行可能满足 => 不拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 50) OR (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        // IS NOT NULL 合取无影响（本就拒绝）\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 50) AND (r.b IS NOT NULL)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // NOT r.b IS NULL 等价 IS NOT NULL\n        rejects(a, \"NOT (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // NOT(r.b > 50)：UNKNOWN 取反仍 UNKNOWN => 拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"NOT (r.b > 50)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // 常量谓词\n        rejects(a, \"FALSE\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"TRUE\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"1 = 1\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        // 只引用左表列：右列全 NULL 与其无关 => 不“因右表 NULL”被拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = 1\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = 1\", Set.of(la), true);\n        // 跨两侧谓词\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = r.b\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(l.a = r.b) OR (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), false);\n\n        // Values 工具\n        a.section(\"表达式：Values 工具\");\n        a.check(\"Long/Double 数值相等\", Values.eq(1L, 1.0) == Boolean.TRUE);\n        a.check(\"null 相等 => null\", Values.eq(null, 1) == null);\n        a.check(\"跨类型 eq => false\", Values.eq(1L, \"1\") == Boolean.FALSE);\n        a.check(\"字符串排序\", Values.compare(\"a\", \"b\") == -1);\n        a.check(\"数值比较 Long/Double\", Values.compare(2L, 1.5) == 1);\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try { Values.compare(1L, \"x\"); } catch (EngineException e) { threw = true; }\n        a.check(\"不可比较类型抛 EngineException\", threw);\n    }\n\n    private static void rejects(Assert a, String text, Set<RefKey> nulled, boolean expected) {\n        Expr e = ExprParser.parse(text);\n        a.check(\"rejectsNulls(\" + text + \")=\" + expected,\n                e.rejectsNulls(nulled) == expected);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":76,"oldLines":7,"newStart":76,"newLines":7,"lines":["         }"," ","         // 整数不应被解析成浮点","-        Expr litCmp = (Expr.Cmp) gt;","+        Expr.Cmp litCmp = null);","originalFile":"package ppd.tests;\n\nimport ppd.EngineException;\nimport ppd.Expr;\nimport ppd.ExprParser;\nimport ppd.RefKey;\nimport ppd.Values;\n\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/** 表达式解析、三值逻辑求值与 NULL 拒绝性分析的单元测试。 */\npublic class ExprTest {\n\n    private static Object eval(Expr e, Object rv) {\n        return e.eval((q, n) -> {\n            if (n.equals(\"b\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"r\"))) return rv;\n            if (n.equals(\"a\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"l\"))) return rv;\n            return null;\n        });\n    }\n\n    public static void run(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"表达式：解析与三值逻辑\");\n\n        // 比较的三值逻辑\n        Expr gt = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b > 50\");\n        a.check(\"50<NULL 比较 => UNKNOWN\", eval(gt, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"100>50 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(gt, 100L)));\n        a.check(\"10>50 => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(gt, 10L)));\n\n        Expr eq = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL=1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(eq, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"1=1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(eq, 1L)));\n\n        Expr ne = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b <> 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL<>1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(ne, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"2<>1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(ne, 2L)));\n\n        Expr isnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(isnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(isnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr notnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NOT NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NOT NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NOT NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(notnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr andExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\");\n        a.check(\"AND: UNKNOWN AND FALSE => FALSE\",\n                Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(andExpr, null)));\n        a.check(\"AND: 5 在区间 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(andExpr, 5L)));\n\n        Expr orExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\");\n        a.check(\"OR: NULL OR NULL => UNKNOWN\", eval(orExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"OR: 2 命中 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(orExpr, 2L)));\n\n        Expr notExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"NOT (r.b = 1)\");\n        a.check(\"NOT UNKNOWN => UNKNOWN\", eval(notExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"NOT TRUE => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notExpr, 1L)));\n\n        // 算术与字符串\n        Expr add = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b + 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL+1 => NULL\", eval(add, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"41+1 => 42 (Long)\", Long.valueOf(42L).equals(eval(add, 41L)));\n        Expr concat = ExprParser.parse(\"'x' + r.b\");\n        a.check(\"字符串拼接\", \"x1\".equals(eval(concat, 1L)));\n\n        // 解析往返\n        String[] roundTrip = {\n                \"(l.a = r.b)\", \"(r.b IS NOT NULL)\", \"((r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10))\",\n                \"((r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2))\", \"(NOT (r.b = 1))\", \"((r.b + 1) * 2)\"\n        };\n        for (String s : roundTrip) {\n            Expr e = ExprParser.parse(s);\n            Expr again = ExprParser.parse(e.toSql());\n            a.check(\"往返解析: \" + s, e.toSql().equals(again.toSql()));\n        }\n\n        // 整数不应被解析成浮点\n        Expr.Cmp litCmp = (Expr.Cmp) gt;\n        a.check(\"整数字面量保持 Long\",\n                ((Expr.Lit) litCmp.right()).value() instanceof Long);\n\n        // 括号与优先级\n        Expr mix = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2 AND r.b > 0\");\n        a.check(\"AND 优先级高于 OR\",\n                mix instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op, Expr l, Expr r)\n                        && op == Expr.LogicOp.OR\n                        && r instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op2, Expr x, Expr y)\n                        && op2 == Expr.LogicOp.AND);\n\n        a.section(\"表达式：NULL 拒绝性判定（保留行模型）\");\n        RefKey rb = new RefKey(\"r\", \"b\");\n        RefKey la = new RefKey(\"l\", \"a\");\n\n        rejects(a, \"r.b > 50\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b = 1\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b <> 1\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b + 1 = 2\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b IS NULL\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b IS NOT NULL\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // 含 IS NULL 的析取：保留行可能满足 => 不拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 50) OR (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        // IS NOT NULL 合取无影响（本就拒绝）\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 50) AND (r.b IS NOT NULL)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // NOT r.b IS NULL 等价 IS NOT NULL\n        rejects(a, \"NOT (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // NOT(r.b > 50)：UNKNOWN 取反仍 UNKNOWN => 拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"NOT (r.b > 50)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // 常量谓词\n        rejects(a, \"FALSE\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"TRUE\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"1 = 1\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        // 只引用左表列：右列全 NULL 与其无关 => 不“因右表 NULL”被拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = 1\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = 1\", Set.of(la), true);\n        // 跨两侧谓词\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = r.b\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(l.a = r.b) OR (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), false);\n\n        // Values 工具\n        a.section(\"表达式：Values 工具\");\n        a.check(\"Long/Double 数值相等\", Values.eq(1L, 1.0) == Boolean.TRUE);\n        a.check(\"null 相等 => null\", Values.eq(null, 1) == null);\n        a.check(\"跨类型 eq => false\", Values.eq(1L, \"1\") == Boolean.FALSE);\n        a.check(\"字符串排序\", Values.compare(\"a\", \"b\") == -1);\n        a.check(\"数值比较 Long/Double\", Values.compare(2L, 1.5) == 1);\n        boolean threw = false;\n        try { Values.compare(1L, \"x\"); } catch (EngineException e) { threw = true; }\n        a.check(\"不可比较类型抛 EngineException\", threw);\n    }\n\n    private static void rejects(Assert a, String text, Set<RefKey> nulled, boolean expected) {\n        Expr e = ExprParser.parse(text);\n        a.check(\"rejectsNulls(\" + text + \")=\" + expected,\n {\n        return e.eval((q, n) -> {\n            if (n.equals(\"b\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"r\"))) return rv;\n            if (n.equals(\"a\") && (q == null || q.equals(\"l\"))) return rv;\n            return null;\n        });\n    }\n\n    public static void run(Assert a) {\n        a.section(\"表达式：解析与三值逻辑\");\n\n        // 比较的三值逻辑\n        Expr gt = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b > 50\");\n        a.check(\"50<NULL 比较 => UNKNOWN\", eval(gt, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"100>50 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(gt, 100L)));\n        a.check(\"10>50 => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(gt, 10L)));\n\n        Expr eq = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL=1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(eq, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"1=1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(eq, 1L)));\n\n        Expr ne = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b <> 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL<>1 => UNKNOWN\", eval(ne, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"2<>1 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(ne, 2L)));\n\n        Expr isnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(isnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(isnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr notnull = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b IS NOT NULL\");\n        a.check(\"NULL IS NOT NULL => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notnull, null)));\n        a.check(\"1 IS NOT NULL => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(notnull, 1L)));\n\n        Expr andExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b > 1) AND (1 = 2)\");\n        a.check(\"AND: UNKNOWN AND FALSE => FALSE\",\n                Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(andExpr, null)));\n        a.check(\"AND: 5>1 AND TRUE => TRUE\",\n                Boolean.TRUE.equals(ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\")\n                        .eval(envOf(5L))));\n        a.check(\"AND: UNKNOWN AND TRUE => UNKNOWN\",\n                ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b > 1) AND (1 = 1)\").eval(envOf(null)) == null);\n\n        Expr orExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\");\n        a.check(\"OR: NULL OR NULL => UNKNOWN\", eval(orExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"OR: 2 命中 => TRUE\", Boolean.TRUE.equals(eval(orExpr, 2L)));\n\n        Expr notExpr = ExprParser.parse(\"NOT (r.b = 1)\");\n        a.check(\"NOT UNKNOWN => UNKNOWN\", eval(notExpr, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"NOT TRUE => FALSE\", Boolean.FALSE.equals(eval(notExpr, 1L)));\n\n        // 算术与字符串\n        Expr add = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b + 1\");\n        a.check(\"NULL+1 => NULL\", eval(add, null) == null);\n        a.check(\"41+1 => 42 (Long)\", Long.valueOf(42L).equals(eval(add, 41L)));\n        Expr concat = ExprParser.parse(\"'x' + r.b\");\n        a.check(\"字符串拼接\", \"x1\".equals(eval(concat, 1L)));\n\n        // 解析往返\n        String[] roundTrip = {\n                \"(l.a = r.b)\", \"(r.b IS NOT NULL)\", \"((r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10))\",\n                \"((r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2))\", \"(NOT (r.b = 1))\", \"((r.b + 1) * 2)\"\n        };\n        for (String s : roundTrip) {\n            Expr e = ExprParser.parse(s);\n            Expr again = ExprParser.parse(e.toSql());\n            a.check(\"往返解析: \" + s, e.toSql().equals(again.toSql()));\n        }\n\n        // 整数不应被解析成浮点\n        Expr.Cmp litCmp = (Expr.Cmp) gt;\n        a.check(\"整数字面量保持 Long\",\n                ((Expr.Lit) litCmp.right()).value() instanceof Long);\n\n        // 括号与优先级\n        Expr mix = ExprParser.parse(\"r.b = 1 OR r.b = 2 AND r.b > 0\");\n        a.check(\"AND 优先级高于 OR\",\n                mix instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op, Expr l, Expr r)\n                        && op == Expr.LogicOp.OR\n                        && r instanceof Expr.Logic(Expr.LogicOp op2, Expr x, Expr y)\n                        && op2 == Expr.LogicOp.AND);\n\n        a.section(\"表达式：NULL 拒绝性判定（保留行模型）\");\n        RefKey rb = new RefKey(\"r\", \"b\");\n        RefKey la = new RefKey(\"l\", \"a\");\n\n        rejects(a, \"r.b > 50\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b = 1\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b <> 1\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b + 1 = 2\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b IS NULL\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"r.b IS NOT NULL\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b = 1) OR (r.b = 2)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 1) AND (r.b < 10)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // 含 IS NULL 的析取：保留行可能满足 => 不拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 50) OR (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        // IS NOT NULL 合取无影响（本就拒绝）\n        rejects(a, \"(r.b > 50) AND (r.b IS NOT NULL)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // NOT r.b IS NULL 等价 IS NOT NULL\n        rejects(a, \"NOT (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // NOT(r.b > 50)：UNKNOWN 取反仍 UNKNOWN => 拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"NOT (r.b > 50)\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        // 常量谓词\n        rejects(a, \"FALSE\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"TRUE\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"1 = 1\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        // 只引用左表列：右列全 NULL 与其无关 => 不“因右表 NULL”被拒绝\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = 1\", Set.of(rb), false);\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = 1\", Set.of(la), true);\n        // 跨两侧谓词\n        rejects(a, \"l.a = r.b\", Set.of(rb), true);\n        rejects(a, \"(l.a = r.b) OR (r.b IS NULL)\", Set.of(rb), false);\n\n        // Values 工具\n        a.section(\"表达式：Values 工具\");\n        a.check(\"Long/Double 数值相等\", Values.eq(1L, 1.0) == Boolean.TRUE);\n        a.check(\"null 相等 => null\", Values.eq(null, 1) == null);\n        a.check(\"跨类型 eq => false\", Values.eq(1L, \"1\") == Boolean.FALSE);\n        a.check(\"字符串排序\", Values.compare(\"a\", \"b\") ==    a.check(\"不可比较类型抛 EngineException\", threw);\n    }\n\n    private static void rejects(Assert a, String text, Set<RefKey> nulled, boolean expected) {\n        Expr e = ExprParser.parse(text);\n }\n\n    public List<String> columnNames() { return columnNames; }\n\n    public List<Row> rows() { return rows; }\n\n    public Schema schema() {\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : columnNames) {\n            // 基表列允许为 NULL（不额外维护 NOT NULL 约束）\n            cols.add(new Column(qualifier, name, true));\n        }\n        return new Schema(cols);\n    }\n\n    /** 从 JSON 请求构造表：{name, alias?, columns:[...], rows:[[...]]}。 */\n    public static Table fromJson(Map<String, Object> def) {\n        String name = Json.getStr(def, \"name\");\n        String alias = Json.getStr(def, \"alias\");\n        String qualifier = alias != null ? alias : name;\n        List<String> columns = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object c : Json.arr(def.get(\"columns\"))) columns.add(c.toString());\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object rowObj : Json.arr(def.get(\"rows\"))) {\n            List<Object> raw = Json.arr(rowObj);\n            if (raw.size() != columns.size()) {\n                throw new EngineException(\"表 \" + name + \" 某行列数不匹配\");\n            }\n            rows.add(new Row(coerceValues(raw)));\n        }\n        return new Table(qualifier, columns, rows);\n    }\n\n    static List<Object> coerceValues(List<Object> raw) {\n        List<Object> out = new ArrayList<>(raw.size());\n        for (Object v : raw) out.add(coerce(v));\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    static Object coerce(Object v) {\n        if (v instanceof Integer i) return i.longValue();\n        return v;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":14,"oldLines":7,"newStart":14,"newLines":7,"lines":["     public Table(String qualifier, List<String> columnNames, List<Row> rows) {","         this.qualifier = qualifier;","         this.columnNames = List.copyOf(columnNames);","-        this.rows = List.copyOf(rows);","+        this.rows = new ArrayList<>(rows);
